title: Landscape Technician 1
description:
Location: Richmond,California,United States

Rubicon Landscape is more than a landscaping company—we're a mission-driven division of Rubicon Programs, a nonprofit dedicated to transforming East Bay communities. As a Landscape Technician I, you'll help deliver exceptional landscape services while supporting a social enterprise that reinvests our proceeds into job training, financial education, and other life-changing services. This is your opportunity to build a rewarding career while making a meaningful impact in the communities we serve.

Position Type: Full time

Location: (Livermore, Menlo Park, Palo Alto, Treasure Island)

Landguage: Bilingual Spanish

RESPONSIBILITIES

Position Summary

The Landscape Technician I performs a variety of landscape installation, enhancement, irrigation, and maintenance services under the direction of a Crew Lead or Supervisor. This entry-level to developing role supports landscape construction projects, special improvement work, and routine landscape maintenance while learning industry best practices, equipment operation, and safe work procedures.

Landscape Technician I employees are expected to work safely, demonstrate reliability, and contribute to high-quality workmanship while developing the skills necessary to advance within the organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Landscape Installation & Enhancement

  • Install trees, shrubs, groundcover, annuals, and other plant materials according to project plans and specifications.
  • Prepare planting areas through basic grading, soil amendment, excavation, and finish work.
  • Install sod, seed, mulch, decorative rock, edging, and other landscape materials.
  • Assist with site improvements, including basic grading, compacting, leveling, and preparation of decomposed granite pathways and seating areas.
  • Basic knowledge of retaining walls, drainage, and related features.
  • Assist with the removal of existing landscape materials, irrigation components, concrete, and debris as directed
  • Assist with project mobilization, site preparation, material staging, and final site cleanup.

Irrigation

  • Assist with the installation, modification, and testing of irrigation systems, including trenching and installing pipe, sprinkler heads, and drip systems according to specifications.
  • Identify and report irrigation deficiencies or water waste

Landscape Maintenance

  • Perform mowing, edging, trimming, pruning, blowing, weed management, and litter removal.
  • Monitor plant health and report pests, diseases, irrigation issues, or safety hazards.
  • Apply mulch and other landscape materials as directed.
  • Maintain clean, professional, and safe job sites.

Equipment & Safety

  • Safely operate hand tools and power equipment including string trimmers, hedge trimmers, backpack blowers, chainsaws (when qualified), compact equipment, and other landscape tools.
  • Conduct daily equipment inspections and report maintenance needs.
  • Follow company safety policies, OSHA requirements, and all client-specific safety procedures.
  • Properly use required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Assist with loading, unloading, securing, and transporting equipment and materials.

Teamwork & Customer Service

  • Follow directions from Crew Leads and Supervisors.
  • Work cooperatively with team members to complete projects efficiently.
  • Maintain professional conduct when interacting with clients, vendors, and the public.
  • Support Rubicon's mission by treating coworkers, participants, and customers with dignity and respect.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • One+ year of landscape, construction, maintenance, or related outdoor labor experience preferred.
  • Willingness to learn commercial landscape installation and maintenance practices.
  • Ability to safely use basic landscape tools and equipment.
  • This position may require driving vehicles and trailers; therefore, proof of a valid and current real ID driver's license and an acceptable Motor Vehicle Report are required.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Basic understanding of landscape installation and maintenance practices.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding outdoor work in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.
  • Strong work ethic and reliability.
  • Basic knowledge of safe equipment operation.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while contributing to a team environment.
  • Commitment to quality workmanship and continuous improvement.
  • Basic technology skills, or willingness to learn, for timekeeping, communication, project tracking, and other job-related tasks.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds; occasionally up to 75 pounds with assistance.
  • Walk, stand, bend, kneel, squat, climb, and perform repetitive motions throughout the workday.
  • Operate hand tools and power equipment safely.
  • Work outdoors in varying temperatures, weather conditions, dust, noise, and uneven terrain.

Working Conditions

  • Outdoor work year-round.
  • Exposure to varying weather conditions.
  • Regular use of power equipment and machinery.
  • Travel between multiple job sites as assigned.
  • Overtime, weekend, or emergency work may occasionally be required.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay Range: $24.00 - $28.00
  • Medical, Dental and Vision health plans. Kaiser and Sutter Health options.
  • 3 weeks paid vacation and sick leave, 13 paid holidays.
  • 4 days paid restorative holiday between Christmas and New Years.
  • Employer sponsored retirement plan.
  • A safety-focused, professional workplace.
  • Year-round, full-time position.
  • Competitive hourly pay, including federal prevailing wage for some assignments.
  • Company uniform with free laundering and mending.
  • Advancement opportunitie

E-Verify

  • Rubicon uses E-Verify to validate the eligibility of our new employees to work legally in the United States.

About Rubicon

An $18M non-profit Rubicon, provides direct services at eight locations in Alameda and Contra Costa counties and operates a growing commercial landscape social enterprise program that is a leader in sustainable practices. Rubicon transforms East Bay communities by equipping people to break the cycle of poverty. Recognized as a national leader in workforce development, Rubicon provides individualized one-on-one career advising, job search support, financial education, wellness and legal services, to very low-income people who face significant barriers to achieving economic mobility.

Rubicon is a 2022 Great Place to Work, on a journey towards becoming a high-road employer and an anti-racist organization. We are committed to systems change and advocacy through efforts like expanding and deepening Employee Resource Groups; the launch of an internal Racial Justice Task Force; and implementation of talent and culture supports that acknowledge and facilitate healing from the direct and indirect effects of racial trauma.

Rubicon actively recruits staff members with a diversity of culture, thought, and lived experiences who are not only highly skilled, but who consistently demonstrate a commitment to our vision of an East Bay without poverty and are passionate about this work.

Rubicon is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and values the diversity of culture, thought and lived experiences. We seek talented, qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, marital status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, conviction history, uniform service membership/veteran status, physical or mental disability, protected medical conditions, genetic characteristics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression regardless of physical gender, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.

Rubicon uses E- Verify to validate the eligibility of our new employees to work legally in the United States.

title: Triage RN
description:
HealthPartners North Suburban Family Physicians has an exciting opportunity for a Triage RN to join our team! This .80 fte position will be based at our Lino Lakes clinic with potential for coverage at our Roseville or Hugo clinics.

This position will work in clinic Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday days (start time between 7:45am – 8:30am and end time between 4:15pm – 5pm).

This position provides triage support for our clinic at the North Suburban Family Physicians clinics by using protocols embedded in the electronic medical record and a variety of resources including standing orders and protocols. This position also includes occasionally working with patients that have questions or needs once on-site. In addition, this role provides comprehensive assessments to establish and evaluate a plan of care and address changes in a patient’s condition, delegates nursing tasks when appropriate and provides supervision and monitoring of function or activity, creates and implements dynamic teaching plans based upon identified patient need and acts as a resource for other staff.

Required Qualifications:

  1. Graduate of an accredited school of nursing

  2. Current RN licensure in Minnesota

  3. Current RN licensure in Wisconsin (within two months of hire)

  4. Current BLS certification for health professionals through the American Heart Association or Red Cross required and maintained. On-line BLS certification is not acceptable.

  5. Strongly demonstrated written and oral communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • One-year full-time employment as an RN

  • Triage or Care Management experience within the last three years

Accountabilities include the following:

Nursing Process:

  1. Nursing assessment is accomplished through interviewing, observation, and/or nursing procedures.

  2. Problem identification defines the impact of health problems affecting individuals and families. Registered nurses distinguish between normal and abnormal findings in order to identify patient capabilities and limitations.

  3. Planning is the process of making decisions and setting goals which are mutually acceptable to the nurse and all pertinent others.

  4. Implementation is the process of providing comprehensive nursing care.

  5. Evaluation includes assessment and reassessment of the patient’s progress toward goal achievement.

Performance is up to standard when:

  • Nursing care demonstrates clinical competence in using the nursing process to provide care to patients and their families, implements established Nursing Policies and Procedures and Standing Orders and provides emotional, intellectual and psychological support to patients and their families.

  • Documents accurately and completely and keeps record regarding clinical practice.

  • Consultation/collaboration: shares information with other members of the health care team, makes appropriate patient referrals, uses interdisciplinary resources to enhance own clinical decision making, provides continuity among home, office, inpatient setting and community, uses appropriate systems, automated or manual, to obtain patient information or schedule appointments.

Care Coordination:

Care Coordination is the ongoing support of patients and their families over time as they navigate care and relationships. It assists patients/families to optimally manage their health care, respect their culture and values and helps to identify individual needs, health goals and treatment preferences.

Performance is up to standard when:

  • Uses health coaching techniques to elicit patient goals and priorities to develop individualized patient action plans

  • Uses population management tools such as registries to identify high risk patients and track, monitor and follow-up with their care

  • Engages, assesses readiness to learn and educates patients and families to implement strategies to reach a desired goal or care intervention

  • Identifies and secures patient services needed for patient care

  • Informs and supports patients and families to assist them in making informed decisions and navigate the healthcare system.

Education:

Education imparts knowledge designed to develop skills, to enhance decision-making, and to promote understanding. It includes interaction with the patient, family and community, as well as participating in formal and informal professional education,

Performance is up to standard when:

  • Patient / Family / Community works in partnership with patient/family to identify patient and family needs and develop a plan for education and/or make appropriate nursing referrals, teaches techniques or knowledge necessary for prevention, self-care management or rehabilitation, engages in ongoing evaluation of the effectiveness of teaching in terms of understanding and application.

  • Professional: Participates in patient care conferences, in-services and educational programs, keeps current on best practices related to nursing and patient care.

Leadership:

Nursing leadership is the possession of skills and knowledge to manage situations, assess problems and facilitate solutions. It includes listening, decision-making, delegating, communication, motivating, facilitating, role modeling, critical thinking and problem solving.

Performance is up to standard when:

  • Role Modeling: serves as a role model in the enhancements of nursing practice and professional conduct, demonstrates flexibility in performing additional responsibilities to contribute to the improvements in patient care and the functioning of the care unit and other support services provides support to professional and technical staff.

  • Goal Determination/Achievement formulates and attains personal and professional goals which promote individual growth, and support the organization vision, mission and values.

  • Decision-Making/Problem-Solving demonstrates ability to assess and problem solve, serves as a catalyst for improving standards of practice

  • Communication skills demonstrate positive verbal and written communication and effective listening skills with internal and external customers.

  • Delegates appropriately and holds self and others accountable for safe delivery of the delegated care.

Professionalism:

Professionalism includes knowledge, self-direction, accountability and the ability to use sound critical judgment in decision-making.

Performance is up to standard when:

  • Acts as a patient advocate, maintains patient confidentiality and provides current health education about diagnostic and prescribed treatments

  • Selects and participates in appropriate professional conferences, workshops and continuing education and committees.

  • Participates in and utilizes research appropriate to clinical setting to improve patient care.

  • Remains accountable for the efficient use of time, material and human resources, assists with the updating of current and development of new procedures as appropriate and adheres to nursing standards of conduct, performance and ethics.

Organizational Behaviors:

Organizational behavior is the building and maintaining of solid interdependent relationships within the care unit, and throughout North Suburban Family Physicians

Performance is up to standard when:

  • Shows interest in and keeps informed of department and organizational changes within the North Suburban Family Physicians system.

  • Provides honest, respectful and constructive input and feedback.

  • Identifies and works to resolve problems with other departments and individuals in a constructive manner.

  • Focuses on solving the problem, not blaming.

  • Effectively shares job knowledge with new employees.

  • Places team goals above own interests.

  • The RNs may be assigned to work at any of the North Suburban Family Physicians clinics depending on clinic need.

  • Other tasks as assigned by supervisor.

THE UNIVERSITY OF TENNESSEE HEALTH SCIENCES

The University of Tennessee Health Sciences is a statewide flagship, public, academic health institution in Tennessee. Founded in 1911, the mission of the University of Tennessee Health Sciences is to improve the health and well-being of Tennesseans and the global community by fostering collaborative education, research, scientific discovery, clinical care, and public service. Employing more than 4,600 people on its faculty, staff, and not-for-profit corporation faculty practice groups, and with more than 3,200 students across the state, UT Health Sciences contributes $4 billion to the economy of Tennessee.

Part of the University of Tennessee System, the Health Sciences is headquartered in Memphis and includes all six of UT’s doctoral-degree-granting health science colleges -- Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Graduate Health Sciences, and Health Professions. UT Health Sciences spans the state with its four major, regional clinical health science locations in Memphis, Knoxville, Chattanooga, and Nashville, as well as more than 100 clinical education sites across Tennessee. UT Health Sciences is the largest educator of health care professionals in the state and operates the state’s largest residency and fellowship advanced training programs.

Located in West Tennessee on the banks of the Mississippi River, Memphis is the second-largest city in the state and among the largest cities in the Southeast. The Greater Memphis metropolitan area has more than 1.3 million residents, and the city ranks among those with the lowest cost of living in the country. It is home to a vibrant restaurant scene, a revitalized Downtown, the Midtown Arts District, many scenic neighborhoods, an active medical district, and a burgeoning airport in the midst of a $214 million modernization.

Memphis boasts attractions, including Elvis Presley’s Graceland, the Memphis Grizzlies, historic Beale Street, the National Civil Rights Museum, the second-largest urban county park in the United States, and the Memphis in May World Championship Barbecue Cooking Contest.

title: Digital Data Product Analyst
description:
The Data Product Analyst serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders, analytics teams, and data management groups.   • Bachelor's degree in information systems, business analysis, or related fields.

  • Skilled at requirements elicitation, process mapping, and translating business needs into technical specifications.
  • Skilled in crafting user stories, acceptance criteria, and high‑quality product and data documentation to support scalable, repeatable workflows.
  • Strong understanding of data stewardship principles, including data quality, lineage, metadata management, and responsible data use and the ability to adapt analytical and stewardship skills across a wide range of client use cases.

  • Excellent communication, with the ability to tailor messages for both technical teams (engineering, data science) and business stakeholders (club personnel, league departments).

  • Naturally curious, with a passion for exploring new data sources, uncovering insights, and improving data quality.
  • Strong critical thinking and structured problem‑solving, especially when interpreting incomplete, messy, or evolving datasets.
  • Strong analytical toolkit leveraging SQL, Python, and data querying tools to explore, transform, and validate complex datasets that span across multiple product disciplines.

  • Problem Framers: You’re comfortable sitting with a business stakeholder, untangling a vague request, and turning it into something buildable.
  • Storytellers: You're comfortable presenting complex data and AI-driven insights in a way that engages and excites stakeholders.
  • Action Takers: You thrive on challenges, taking ownership of a variety of responsibilities to deliver high-quality results.
  • Lifelong Learners: You're always eager to step outside your comfort zone and dive into the intricacies of one of the most complex business domains.
  • Collaborative Teammates: You possess the technical and interpersonal skills to excel in a cutting-edge software development environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build the data models and pipelines that power TSIQ.
  • Develop semantic models so that AI agents reason over trading, risk, and prime brokerage data with precision and consistency.
  • Build, test, and iterate on AI agents using prompt engineering and context engineering.
  • Implement guardrails, evaluation, and governance controls that keep AI agents accurate, safe, and auditable.
  • Deliver analytics and rapid prototypes in Streamlit to put capabilities in front of users early.
  • Perform business analysis—gather requirements from stakeholders, translate them into technical designs, and validate that what we ship answers the real question.
  • Collaborate with a global team of developers in a fast-paced, innovative setting.

What You Bring

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python, including the ability to contribute to structured, production-grade codebases—not just notebooks.
  • Experience designing data models and building data pipelines, including transformation frameworks such as dbt.
  • Semantic modeling experience—defining metrics, dimensions, and business logic that downstream consumers depend on.
  • Practical prompt engineering and context engineering skills, with a focus on making AI outputs reliable and repeatable.
  • Experience building AI agents and implementing guardrails to govern their behavior (a strong plus).
  • Streamlit or comparable experience building lightweight data applications.
  • Business analysis skills—requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, and documentation.
  • Exceptional communication skills. This role sits between business stakeholders and the platform, so clear written and verbal communication is essential.
  • Capital markets or financial services domain experience. This is extremely important to us—understanding trading, risk, or prime brokerage workflows will set you apart.

Why Join TS Imagine?

  • On-site role—4 days per week in our Montreal office, with 1 day of flexibility.
  • Unlimited vacation + 3 personal days.
  • Annual bonus and salary review.
  • $1,500 training budget to fuel your growth.
  • RRSP matching (3% company contribution).
  • Comprehensive health insurance.
  • Subsidized public transportation (Opus & Cie).
  • Join a global team with 10 offices worldwide and the opportunity to make a real impact on the financial industry.

Note: This role is not remote—applicants must be based in Montreal.

title: Cardiovascular Technologist - Cardiac Cath/EP Lab - York Hospital - Full-Time - Day
description:
Schedule

Full-Time: 40 Hours/Weekly

0630-1700

Late Stay call requirement

General Summary

Provides technical support and assistance to the physician during heart and vascular procedures. Performs scrub and hemodynamic monitoring duties with cardiac catheterizations using clinical knowledge, technical skills, and professional judgment in accordance with professional and departmental standards and protocols. Provides care, assessment prior, during and post-procedural instruction to patients. Prepares and maintains all pertinent information related to procedures.

Essential Functions:

  • Assists and performs diagnostic invasive procedures in the heart and vascular labs. Provides care for patients prior, during and after procedures. Scrubs and assists physicians with diagnostic and invasive procedures. Responds to patient distress situations and assists with equipment quality control and inventory management. Prepares sterile trays, instruments, supplies and equipment necessary for procedures, and maintains sterile field. Provides all appropriate services to safely and efficiently complete patient’s procedures. Maintains knowledge of cardiac concepts and clinical practices.
  • Possesses the knowledge & skills level of all procedures performed. Capable of assisting with all new procedures i.e. IVUS, ICE, laser, Impella, extractions etc. Capable of assisting physicians in multiple areas of heart and vascular. Prepares, utilizes, and acts as resource for necessary equipment for each procedure. Possesses the ability and knowledge to troubleshoot all equipment.
  • Proficient at assisting, circulating, recording, and stimming. area specific high complexity interventional procedures. These procedures include but are not limited to: TAVR, Mitral Clip, Valvuloplasty, Atherectomy, Laser procedures, Atrial appendage Occluders, Complex Coronary Interventions including Chronic Total Occlusions, TEVAR, EVAR, Neuro Coiling, Stroke Revascularization, Carotid Stenting, Advanced Ablations, Extractions, and Device Implantations. Able to utilize non-invasive equipment during procedures including intracardiac echo (ICE) and ultrasound technologies. All technologists will be proficient/competent utilizing imaging equipment.
  • Must be Cross-Trained in multiple areas to do multiple types of procedures including but not limited to; Cath/PCI, Vascular, Electrophysiology, Structural Heart, or Endovascular Neurosurgery.
  • Responsible for patient safety in the Cardiac lab and Advanced Procedural Suite. Must be able to recognize cardiac arrhythmias and respond according to emergency protocols. Operates external cardiac pacemaker and defibrillator. Intervenes with appropriate therapy, such as high quality CPR, in the event of cardiac emergencies.
  • As procedures require, will monitor and record patient hemodynamic status during procedures. Performs calculations and processes data based on collected hemodynamic data. Confirms all procedural and equipment charges are accurate, proper orders are signed and charted, and all procedural documentation is completed.
  • Assumes call responsibilities as required to assure complete call coverage.

Common Expectations:

  • Follows radiation safety policies as outlined by the NRC and York Hospital’s Radiation Safety Committee. Ensures radiation safety for all team members and patients. Wears proper radiation safety attire (lead apron, lead goggles and radiation badge). Maintains proper distance from radiation source when obtainable.
  • Properly handles and processes images to include storage and transfer. Ensures correct patient and physician information at start and completion of procedures. Capable of copying and supplying images via CD/DVD to patients, physicians and other facilities for continuing care purposes. Capable of obtaining and transferring images to and from various facilities. For Invasive Cardiology/Electrophysiology Technologists, they must be able to perform queries from Xper, Xcelera. Visage, and EPIC.
  • Must obtain and maintain area specific certifications and maintain a satisfactory level on yearly evaluations.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to patient, visitor and staff by: complying with all applicable safety regulations; learning the impact of medical errors and methodology that will lead to reduction of errors; reporting actual and potential errors, as well as hazardous conditions; identifying opportunities to standardize processes that will lead to increased safety; and participating in safety education programs and root cause analyses as required.
  • Maintains established policies and procedures, objectives, quality assessment, safety, environmental and infection control standards. Prepares and maintains written documentation as required by the profession and the department.
  • Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs and current literature. Attends in-services, workshops and staff meetings as required.
  • Active in two or more approved activities Ex: committees, radiation safety officer, coding. Attends offsite training/educational conferences. Provides formal presentation of information obtained at educational conferences and training sites to staff within 30 days of conference/training. May include but not limited to poster and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Acts as preceptor/mentor to students and staff members in procedural areas. Includes but not limited to assisting, circulating, monitoring, and stimming. Precepts new staff on procedures such as complex Neuro, Vascular, PCI/CTO, Structural Heart, Electrophysiology, and all new procedures. Adheres to the educational guidelines provided through Wellspan education services, the department education committee, and the department specific Educator.
  • Demonstrates proficient inter-departmental communication and interaction within Wellspan and other facilities. Ambassador to visiting staff and physicians.
  • Provides outstanding service to all customers; fosters teamwork; and practices fiscal responsibility through improvement and innovation.

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

  • Certificate Program Diploma from an accredited school of Cardiovascular/Radiology Technology. Required or
  • Associates Degree Degree from an accredited school of Cardiovascular/Radiology Technology. Required

Work Experience:

  • 5 years Of Cardiovascular, Vascular Interventional, Interventional Radiology, Electrophysiology or Neuro Interventional experience. Required

Licenses:

  • Registered Cardiac Invasive Specialist Upon Hire Required or
  • Registered Technologist-Radiography - ARRT Upon Hire Required or
  • Registered Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist Upon Hire Required or
  • Registered Technologist-Cardiac Interventional Radiology - ARRT Upon Hire Required or
  • Registered Technologist-Vascular Interventional Radiology - ARRT Upon Hire Required and
  • Basic Life Support Upon Hire Required and
  • Advanced Cardiac Life Support Upon Hire Required

  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts
  • Retirement savings plan

  • Short-term disability
  • Education assistance
  • Financial education and support, including DailyPay
  • Wellness and Wellbeing programs

  • Childcare referral service via Wellthy

title: Senior BI Developer (m/f/d) - Microsoft Fabric & Power BI
description:
Remote, CET/CEST or SAST-aligned time zones | Full-time | Start: as soon as possible

Build business-critical data products that turn trusted data into better decisions and action.

Using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Azure, you will create lakehouses, semantic models, reports and AI-driven data products. These can include automated workflows, bots, copilots and agents.

You use AI-native delivery methods as a professional standard. This includes current LLMs, automation and agent platforms where they improve the product or solve a real client problem.

MultiBase delivers business-critical BI and analytics solutions for mid-sized companies across the DACH region. Since 1991, we have completed 1,500+ projects for 400+ clients. Our work covers manufacturing, automotive, financial services, pharma and other data-intensive sectors.

We are hiring a Senior BI Developer to expand capacity across established long-term client work. You bring technical depth, ownership and the ability to discuss your own technical topics directly with clients.

Tasks

The role

You build, test, document and maintain data products. This includes data models, lakehouses, data warehouses, pipelines, notebooks and Power BI reports.

You report to a Tech Lead and work closely with project leads, other developers and client teams. You clarify the technical detail and estimate the effort before delivery starts. You show what you built and explain your decisions clearly.

Project leadership, commercial ownership and people management remain with the project lead. Your mandate is senior technical delivery, direct technical client communication and reliable execution.

You work within MultiBase's DECIDE delivery framework: Discover, Engage, Clarify, Illustrate, Develop and Embed. You receive structured onboarding into the client context, delivery standards and framework.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain BI and data products in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Azure.
  • Deliver lakehouse, warehouse, pipeline, notebook, SQL object and reporting components.
  • Develop Power BI semantic models, reports and DAX calculations.
  • Translate defined business needs into clear technical stories and delivery steps.
  • Discuss your own technical topics directly with client IT and business stakeholders.
  • Work in structured agile delivery. Estimate work, manage your stories and deliver against sprint commitments.
  • Use AI tools systematically to improve your development, analysis, documentation and quality assurance workflows.
  • Design and develop AI-driven data products that connect trusted client data, LLMs and defined business workflows.
  • Identify and prototype practical use cases for automations, bots, copilots and agents within client data environments.
  • Turn proven AI prototypes into secure, documented and maintainable data products.
  • Test, document and deploy production-ready data products.
  • Use version control and collaborative delivery practices, ideally Git and Azure DevOps.
  • Raise delivery risks, data issues and unclear requirements early with the Tech Lead and project lead.
  • Identify concrete improvement opportunities in client data landscapes.Contribute reusable documentation and practical knowledge to MultiBase's internal knowledge base.

Requirements

Who you are

You are technical first. You also communicate comfortably with a client's controller, data architect or business lead.

You ask clear questions before you build. You explain trade-offs directly. You take responsibility for your work and communicate early when an issue needs attention.

You look beyond dashboards and reports. You recognize when a trusted data product, automated workflow or AI-driven bot, copilot or agent is the right way to create insight or improve a client process.

You enjoy a role with real ownership, direct client exposure and a high standard of delivery.

Essential experience

  • At least four years of BI or data-platform development experience, including direct work with client or business stakeholders.
  • Strong Azure data-platform experience, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory or Synapse.
  • Practical experience with lakehouse and data warehouse concepts, data pipelines and notebooks.
  • Professional Power BI capability, including semantic modeling, DAX and report development.
  • Strong SQL and dimensional data-modeling skills, including star-schema design and ETL/ELT patterns.
  • Experience delivering in agile teams using structured stories, estimates and sprint commitments.
  • Experience using Git and a collaborative development workflow. Azure DevOps is an advantage.
  • Experience testing, deploying and maintaining production data products.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.
  • Daily, thoughtful use of AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or equivalent. You verify outputs and remain accountable for quality.

Strong advantages

  • Hands-on experience designing, building or deploying AI-driven data products, bots, copilots or agents for real business use cases.
  • Experience with current LLMs and small language models, including practical decisions about model choice, cost, latency, privacy and quality.
  • Experience with LLM APIs, agent orchestration or automation platforms such as OpenClaw, Claude Code or Cowork, Hermes, n8n, Make or comparable tools.
  • Experience turning LLM, SLM or agent prototypes into secure and maintainable data products.
  • Databricks experience, especially for data engineering, lakehouse and notebook-based work.
  • Python or PySpark for data engineering, automation or notebook workflows.
  • German at B2 level or above for DACH client communication.
  • Experience delivering in a client-facing project environment.
  • A habit of actively sharing knowledge with teammates and contributing to the growth of company expertise.
  • An active interest in market and technology developments, which you bring back to the team rather than keep to yourself.

Benefits

The working environment

  • Remote-first across CET/CEST or SAST-aligned time zones.
  • Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00 CET/CEST.
  • Occasional client visits are part of the role, normally several times per year and no more than once a quarter.
  • Developers based outside Germany attend working sessions at the MultiBase headquarters in Gilching at least twice a year.
  • Direct access to senior management, the Tech Lead and experienced project leads.
  • Access to current AI and development tools, plus the opportunity to build practical capability in LLMs, SLMs, automation and agent platforms.
  • Long-standing client relationships in which MultiBase is the established, trusted partner for solving real data problems.
  • Compensation: competitive and aligned with market benchmarks, based on experience and location.

Growth path

This role starts with senior hands-on delivery. As MultiBase and its AI-driven data-product work grow, strong performance can lead to broader responsibility in solution architecture, technical leadership, delivery leadership and the development of new client offerings.

The direction depends on your strengths, the company's needs and the results you create.

What success looks like

After three months

  • You understand your client team, their processes and their data landscape.
  • You contribute billable work within the agreed delivery plan.
  • Your data products are tested, documented and ready for production use.
  • You use MultiBase delivery standards and AI-native working practices consistently.
  • You have identified at least one practical AI-driven data-product opportunity for further evaluation.

After six months

  • Client stakeholders trust you with defined technical questions and delivery topics.
  • Your work meets agreed quality standards and peer review requires only minor refinements.
  • You have contributed at least one useful SOP or knowledge-base entry.
  • You have identified at least one concrete improvement opportunity in a client data landscape and discussed it with your Tech Lead and project lead.
  • You have contributed to an AI-driven data product, automation, bot or agent where a defined client use case exists.

MultiBase GmbH | Remote | Full-time

This role is open to all applicants (m/f/d). MultiBase evaluates candidates solely on skills, experience and potential, regardless of gender or gender identity, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, or sexual identity.

title: Strategic Operations Program Manager
description:
The Strategic Operations Program Manager leads the end-to-end execution of strategic account programs across equipment assets lifecycle, including inspection, transportation, refurbishment, redeployment, and resale channels for North America. This role serves as the operational program owner, partnering across Sales, Operations, Logistics, Vendors and Analytics to translate customer and contractual requirements into scalable execution plans. The Program Manager ensures consistent delivery, optimizes asset flow and recovery outcomes, and drives performance through data-driven insights and continuous improvement.

Primary Accountabilities

  1. Program Execution & Asset Lifecycle Management
  • Own the operational execution of assigned Strategic Account programs from intake through completion across the service lifecycle.
  • Translate contractual and strategic account requirements into clear operational workflows, task sequencing, and service milestones.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across inspection, yard operations, logistics, refurbishment and resale.
  • Identify and proactively mitigate risks impacting asset flow, service delivery or financial outcomes
  • Monitor asset progression to ensure cycle time, service quality, and recovery value targets are met.
  • Serve as the primary operational partner for assigned Strategic Accounts across Finance, Construction, OEM, Rental, Insurance, and Manufacturer Consignment segments.
  • Act as the primary operational liaison between Sales, Site Operations, Inspection Operations, Enablement teams, and third-party vendors.
  • Ensure alignment between customer commitments and operational execution across multiple sites and service providers.
  • Support the rollout of customized service offerings such as a dedicated asset program, redeployment strategies, or non-auction solutions.

  • Partner with account and operations stakeholders to resolve escalations impacting service quality, timelines, or customer satisfaction.

    2. Program Governance, Coordination & Communication

  • Maintain and manage program governance artifacts including workstream trackers, action registers, service requirement documentation, and status logs.
  • Support the development and delivery of program updates, executive summaries, and Monthly Business Review (MBR) materials.
  • Facilitate regular status updates and business reviews with internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Document and support standardization of processes across sites to improve consistency and scalability.

  • Ensure clear and consistent communication of priorities, risks, and performance across distributed teams and locations.

    3. Reporting Analytics & Asset Performance

  • Compile, validate, and maintain operational data across internal systems (e.g., MARS, Oracle, Mercury, Sales Contract Reports, + more) to support program monitoring.
  • Develop and maintain recurring reports and dashboards using Excel, Power BI, Looker, or similar tools.
  • Track and report on KPIs such as asset cycle time, time-to-sale, recovery value, service turnaround, and vendor performance.
  • Identify and analyze trends across categories, geographies, and service lines.
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend actions to improve throughput and financial outcomes.

  • Provide insights and reporting to support customer reviews and internal decision-making.

    4. Continuous Improvement & Operational Optimization

  • Identify operational inefficiencies and recurring execution issues across strategic programs.
  • Partner with operations and enablement teams to implement scalable improvements.
  • Contribute to the evolution of strategic programs and service offerings.
  • Support change management across field operations, vendors, and internal teams.

Knowledge & Experience:

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience · 3+ years of experience in program management, operations, or asset lifecycle environments
  • Experience in multi-site operations, heavy equipment, logistics or industrial services preferred.

Technical/Professional Accreditation:

  • Intermediate to advanced Excel
  • Experience with Power BI or comparable BI tools
  • Familiarity with ERP, asset management, logistics or inventory systems such as MARS, Enrich, Oracle, Mercury, PO/Cost preferred

Required Experience (Type/Amount):

  • Strong program and/or operational management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to coordinate across distributed teams (yards, vendors, logistics)
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority
  • Strong communication skills across sites, corporate and customer audiences.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Ability to manage high-volume, fast-moving operational workflows

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • This role operates in a hybrid environment, including both office and field settings such as equipment yards, inspection sites, and customer or vendor locations
  • Travel may be required (approximately 10–25%) depending on program needs, site locations, and customer engagements
  • Regular interaction with active operational environments, including equipment yards with moving machinery, varying terrain, and outdoor conditions
  • Physical Requirements
  • Ability to safely navigate outdoor industrial environments, including walking on uneven or unpaved surfaces (e.g., gravel, dirt, mud)
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during site visits or operational reviews
  • May occasionally need to climb steps or ladders to access equipment for inspection or review purposes
  • Capability to work in varying weather conditions (heat, cold, wind, rain) when on-site
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), such as safety boots, high-visibility vests, hard hats, and safety glasses
  • Ability to occasionally lift or move items up to 25 pounds, if necessary for site assessments or operational support

Job Summary:

The Installer IV position is an experienced professional who independently executes complex field activities related to installing, maintaining, and servicing telecommunications equipment. This role requires extensive industry knowledge and the ability to guide less experienced installers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Understands and follows Telamon’s established safety practices and procedures.

  • Properly use and maintain personal protective equipment (PPE).

  • Perform additions, removals, and modifications on working equipment and circuits, including:

    • Circuit modifications

    • Software additions or upgrades

    • Power transition work

    • Addition or removal of batteries

  • Addition or removal of circuits on working power distribution sources.

  • Install, configure, and integrate telecommunication equipment such as switches, routers, fiber optics, and power systems in central office environments.

  • Mount racks, frames, and shelves, ensuring all equipment is securely and correctly installed.

  • Perform cable installation, termination, labeling, and lacing, adhering to industry standards.

  • Properly test and troubleshoot fiber/copper installations.

  • Perform power verification and power up equipment.

  • Tests and evaluate systems to determine efficiency, reliability, and compatibility with existing systems.

  • Conduct diagnostic tests on systems and equipment using tools like OTDRs, power meters, and spectrum analyzers.

  • Maintains quality awareness and implements quality control processes.

  • Performs in-process and final quality inspections.

  • Reads and stays current on installation documentation.

  • Successfully interpret drawings, plans, and specifications.

  • Interpret the job plan and scope of work, as well as perform retrofits and upgrades for existing infrastructure.

  • Make recommendations based on applicable codes, standards, and best practices.

  • Discuss media selection and implications for implementation on the network.

  • Resolves job specification and/or drawing problems.

  • Marks/corrects office record drawings.

  • Accurately document installation, testing, and maintenance activities, including as-built drawings and change logs.

  • Executes the essential duties and responsibilities of Installer III, plus additional leadership duties.

  • Provide work instruction to Level I, II, and III Installers; Provide work assignments to Level 1 and 2 Installers.

  • May serve as Site Crew Leader.

  • May perform as the installation in-charge person.

  • Performs as the Installation in-charge person on Common Systems jobs as needed.

  • Prepare Methods of Procedure (MOP).

  • Write Job Information Memorandums (JIMs).

  • Conducts work assignments, communicates, dresses, and assists customers in a professional manner.

  • Coordinate with engineers, project managers, and other team members to align installation plans and schedules.

  • Inventories all job-related material.

  • Addition or removal of non-powered equipment/hardware.

  • Addition or removal of wiring and connections (on non-working equipment only and switchboard cable only).

  • Lead verification/continuity testing.

  • Analysis of job specifications and drawings.

  • Will provide guidance and training to less experienced Installers as requested or required.

  • May perform the duties of a Level III or Level IV Installer when directly supervised by properly qualified personnel.

Managerial Responsibility

  • No direct reports but will provide guidance and oversight to less experienced installers on jobs.

Travel/Shift Requirements

  • Must be available to travel as much as 50% - 75%
  • Travel may require overnight stays away from home for 1-2 weeks at a time, including weekends.

  • Ability to work on ladders and in confined spaces.
  • Work with and around electrical wires and ESD products in a safe manner.

  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend, squat, lift, crawl, push, and pull.

Skills and Abilities Required

  • Proficiency in installing cables, racks, power systems, and grounding systems.

  • Ability to perform equipment rack mounting, cable lacing, and termination.

  • Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the installation process.

  • Read, interpret, and understand technical drawings and documentation.

  • Familiar with industry standards (AT&T TP-76300 / 76409 / Telcordia GR1275 / Verizon IP72202).

  • Complete “Basic Installation” training course or equivalent on-the-job training.

  • Successful completion of Safety, Business Code of Conduct, Quality Assurance, and Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) training.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve technical issues.

  • Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail by executing installations accurately and ensuring full compliance with industry standards.

  • Possess a good understanding of the phases of the installation process.

  • Advanced knowledge of current network products.

  • Ability to lead and direct less experienced team members to complete projects.

  • Efficiently manage time to meet project deadlines.

  • Aptitude and interest in technology with the ability to grasp and apply technical concepts.

  • Proficiency operating computers, tablets, and MS Office software.

  • Ability to effectively communicate with team members, supervisors, and other departments.

  • Possess a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record and proof of insurance.

  • Track and record work hours on a timely basis using time-tracking software.

  • Moderate knowledge of current network products.

  • Good eye and hand coordination, manual dexterity, and precision to work well with a variety of hand tools.

Education and Experience Required

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
CMDP, a Joint Venture between Costain and MWHT, have been selected by Southern Water to deliver essential infrastructure solutions for its next AMP8 investment programme. The award is for an initial seven-year term worth at least £500m to Costain, with an option to extend by up to five years.

Working closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Site Managers, subcontractors and client representatives, the role will ensure that electrical works are delivered safely, efficiently, to the required quality standards and in accordance with programme and commercial requirements.

  • Ensure appropriate electrical isolation, permit-to-work and safe systems of work are implemented.

  • Report and investigate incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions.

  • Ensure electrical installations meet relevant British Standards, industry regulations and client specifications.
  • Inspect and verify completed works before testing and commissioning.
  • Maintain accurate inspection and test records.
  • Support the resolution of defects, snags and non-conformances.

  • Ensure electrical documentation and as-built information is completed accurately.

    Planning & Delivery

  • Work closely with the Site Manager and Project Manager to plan electrical activities and resources.
  • Monitor progress and provide regular updates on programme performance.
  • Identify potential delays, risks and resource constraints.
  • Coordinate testing, commissioning and handover activities.

  • Support project completion and client handover.

    Stakeholder Management

  • Build effective working relationships with clients, subcontractors, suppliers and project teams.
  • Attend site meetings and provide updates on electrical progress.
  • Liaise with engineering teams to resolve design and installation issues.
  • Support commercial teams with information relating to variations, delays and additional works

Essential

  • Proven experience supervising electrical works within construction, engineering, utilities or infrastructure.
  • Electrical qualification such as NVQ Level 3, City & Guilds or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of electrical installation, testing and commissioning.
  • Experience working with electrical systems within a construction or industrial environment.
  • Good knowledge of health, safety and environmental requirements.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics and specifications.
  • Experience managing subcontractors and site-based teams.
  • Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work to programme and manage competing priorities.

Desirable

title: Cardio Studies Unit Trainee -Cath Lab
description:
In a training situation, and initially performing less difficult work; sets up equipment for special procedures x-rays; assists in positioning patients for examination; assists physicians by performing sterile procedures; maintains images and other records; performs related work as required.   1. Assists in performance of special examinations, including but not limited to cardiac angiograms, pacemaker insertions, pressure lines and pulmonary angiography.
  2. Assists in the preparation of images and records for use by providers and other medical personnel.
  3. Assists providers in diagnostic and interventional procedures.
  4. Administers intravenous media; monitors patient reactions to procedures performed.
  5. Operates computerized equipment.
  6. Requisitions necessary drugs and supplies to maintain an adequate level in examination room.
  7. Assists in cleaning special procedures rooms and equipment; makes simple repairs as required.
  8. May perform work of a Registered Diagnostic Technologist.
  9. Demonstrates effective judgement and ability to understand, react competently, and treat (if appropriate) the unique needs of patient age groups served.
  10. Performs other related duties as required, including new improvements and/or technology that relate to job assignment.
  • High school graduate and/or GED equivalent.
  • Completion of a recognized educational program in Diagnostic Radiology.
  • One (1) year of experience as a Registered Diagnostic Radiological Technologist.
  • Working knowledge of the methods and techniques of x-ray photography, including positioning patients, adjusting and operating equipment and processing and developing x-ray films, cine films and videos.
  • Knowledge of human anatomy as related to special radiological, cardiac, diagnostic procedures.
  • Knowledge of effective methods and techniques in administering special procedures x-rays, of the hazards involved in this work for equipment operators and patients, and of effective precautionary measures.
  • Ability to maintain records and files of photographic work.
  • Ability to maintain harmonious relationships with physicians, patients, public and other medical center personnel.

NECESSARY SPECIAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Registration by the ARRT as a Radiologic Technologist

NOTE: Incumbents who have completed a recognized educational program in Diagnostic Radiology will progress to the classification of Cardiovascular Studies Unit Technologist after six months HMC on-the-job Cardiovascular Studies Unit Technologist training. Incumbents who have completed a recognized educational program in Diagnostic Radiology and a recognized educational program in special radiologic procedures (a six month on-the-job-training in special procedures may substitute for the special radiologic procedures educational program) after four months HMC on-the-job Cardiovascular Studies Unit Technologist training. Incumbents must also successful complete their probationary period prior to progressing to the higher classification.

Position Summary:

The person in this position will be responsible for providing a variety of programs in relation to substance abuse for clients participating in the program. Essential job functions include those listed below.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Complete the assessment of each client with the required assessment tools.
  • Initiate and sustain each individual's motivation to participate in treatment, using techniques of engagement including therapeutic relationships, individual counseling, and brief interventions based on the stages of change.
  • Develop a comprehensive service plan for each client that includes the results of assessments, and short- and long-term treatment goals and objectives of the client (the service plan is developed with the input of the client, but within the limitations imposed by IDOC).

  • Maintain all information according to the laws of confidentiality as required by the Federal Register, General Provisions, Title 42, Chapter 1, Part 2, which prohibits making disclosures without the specific written consent of the client, or as otherwise permitted by such regulations.
  • Obtain a signed release of confidential information (disclosure form) from each client authorizing OSAP to review case files for quality assurance reviews and evaluation of WestCare performance, and maintain as a part of the client file.
  • Maintain thorough records of each client's participation, including participant IDOC number, unique identifier for the WestCare program, beginning and ending dates of service, number of hours of participation, and number of days of participation.
  • Submit all individual client data on a weekly basis for entry into the WestCare database.

title: Senior Scheduler
description:
Summary

A Senior Corporate Scheduler develops and maintains software schedules for all assigned construction projects in strategic business unit(s). The Sr. Corporate Scheduler monitors schedule progression against the schedule baseline, explains schedule variances and prepares reports on schedule-related trends; assists the Project Team in understanding the various projects’ outlook. Provides schedule oversight and mentors lower level Project Schedulers. Develops scheduling standards and procedures. A Sr. Corporate Scheduler reports to the Strategic Business Unit Executive; alternatively, may report to a member of the Executive Committee.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develops and maintains schedules for all assigned projects utilizing critical path scheduling techniques.
  • Reviews project schedule data to include records of activities, verifies open/close dates, cost/budgets, structures, and associated data as applicable to activities.
  • Evaluates work packages and other related data for feasibility of implementation. Makes recommendations as to alternative methods or processes that may be utilized to efficiently achieve and maintain desired customer results.
  • Interfaces with internal and external customers to communicate status of work and corrective actions that may be required to ensure conformance to established schedules.
  • Works closely with project team (Project Managers, Superintendents, Project Engineers) to ensure that schedule information is communicated to the parties doing the work.
  • Assists the project team in the development of the Project Management Plans and Cost/Schedule integration.
  • Develops or provides input to the project status reports (such as a critical path analysis) to ensure proper documentation is maintained and complete.
  • Supports construction operations to meet production schedules and recommends revision of schedules as a result of changes during construction.
  • Analyzes project requirements with Project Team and ensures that required resources are available so that established schedules may be reasonably maintained. If resources are not available, notifies supervision and the Project Team of resources issues.

  • Coordinates with internal and external customers to obtain data concerning the status of assigned project activities or milestones.

  • Analyzes work productivity against established schedules and reports to management. Modifies schedules as necessary to efficiently plan and report activities as required.

  • Ensures an audit trail from the initiation of a project to a project’s completion.

  • Prepares project management reports to reflect schedule status and/or corrective actions as required.

  • Coordinates projects with all participants to ensure that plans are achievable and current on a daily basis.

Qualifications

  • B.S. in Construction Management and/or equivalent.

  • Over eight years’ experience equivalent specialized training and work experience.

  • Excellent working knowledge of scheduling software and MS Office software.

  • Ability to independently apply advanced analysis techniques, demonstrate experience in oversight of construction processes and lead others in performing complex, interrelated tasks in an effective and timely manner.

  • Knowledge of various construction industry markets; (e.g. institutional, retail, government, hospitality, and healthcare).

  • Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and coordinate team members.

  • Has integrity: maintains the required standards of ethics, conduct, and organizational policies in job-related activities.

  • Ability to operate office equipment, computer, printer, phone, copier, fax, etc.

  • Effective written, verbal, negotiation and presentation skills.

  • Excellent knowledge of construction practices, methods, trends and crew data.

  • Ability to perform essential duties and responsibilities efficiently, accurately, and safely with or without reasonable accommodation and without posing threat of harm to self or others.

The full salary range for this position is $125,000 to $180,000. This position is eligible for a target bonus.

Benefits - Layton Construction offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-term Disability Insurance, Short-term Disability Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Family Support, Pre-tax Paid Parking/Public Transportation, Paid time off, Time Away Benefits, Paid Holidays, Group Legal, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Identity Theft Protection, Group Legal, Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program.

title: Laminator Operator
description:
The purpose of this position is to attend laminating machine that bonds material, such as plastic or paper. Additionally, this position requires strict adherence to all health and safety regulations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Conveys rolls of materials specified in work order from storage area to laminating machine, using forklift truck.

  2. Positions rolls on machine, using electric pallet jacks.

  3. Pulls end of material from roll onto take up rollers of machine and turns hand wheel that moves carriage to align material with panels.

  4. Turns dials and moves levers to set machine roller speed, roller pressure, and heating unit temperature, following processing specifications.

  5. Turns valve to replenish glue supply.

  6. Depresses buttons to start machine.

  7. Inspects and measures first panels discharged from machine to verify correct alignment of bonded material on panel, using tape measure.

  8. Adjusts controls to correct machine operations such as speed of machine units.

  9. Severs material between laminated panels, using cutter, to free panels discharging onto off bearing conveyor.

  10. Refills glue reservoir as required.

  11. Performs routine maintenance.

  12. Performs required quality checks prior to start-up and during the run of all jobs (ie. Coat weight and ratio mix).

description:
Position: Radiology Coordinator

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Location: Remote

Shift: US Business Hours or After-Hours Shift (Supporting a 24/7 Operation)

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Radiology Coordinator to support our high-volume, 24/7 radiology operations. In this role, you will serve as a crucial liaison between radiologists, hospital staff, and clinical teams to ensure critical diagnostic findings are communicated swiftly and accurately. You will also manage exam prioritization and troubleshoot basic IT or software issues within our clinical systems. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses a solid understanding of medical terminology, and can independently manage time-sensitive tasks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critical Findings & Communication: Accurately and promptly relay critical radiology results and urgent findings to hospitals, referring physicians, and clinical care teams in strict accordance with clinical protocols.
  • Workflow & Exam Coordination: Assist radiologists by tracking, prioritizing, and coordinating incoming diagnostic exams based on clinical urgency.
  • Technical & System Support: Perform basic IT and software troubleshooting to resolve minor system glitches, access issues, or workflow disruptions within the radiology platform.
  • Operations & Monitoring: Actively monitor communication channels, incoming calls, and system alerts to guarantee rapid response times.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain precise, real-time records of all communications, exam updates, and operational activities.
  • Protocol Adherence: Follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) within a 24/7 operational framework while upholding strict patient privacy standards.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: Prior experience in healthcare operations, radiology coordination, or medical administration is strongly preferred. Experience working with US-based healthcare providers or clinics is a significant plus.
  • Medical Terminology: Solid, practical knowledge of medical and radiologic terminology.
  • Technical Skills: Strong aptitude for basic IT troubleshooting and comfortable learning complex healthcare software systems.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to convey urgent clinical data clearly and professionally.
  • Core Competencies: Outstanding attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and the capacity to prioritize effectively under pressure.
  • Remote Readiness: Self-motivated and reliable with a dedicated, quiet home-office setup suitable for handling sensitive medical information.

title: SeniorExecutive
description:
The HR Compliance Senior Executive plays a critical role in ensuring the organization’s adherence to applicable labor laws, employment regulations, and internal HR policies. This role monitors regulatory developments, supports the design and implementation of compliance programs, conducts internal reviews, and provides guidance to mitigate HR-related risks. As a subject matter expert, the incumbent proactively identifies potential compliance gaps and helps foster a culture of ethical, lawful, and consistent employment practices.


  1. Regulatory Monitoring and Research:
  • Monitor changes in local labor laws and regulations, including Philippine labor standards, as well as applicable national, international, industry, and HR compliance requirements.
  • Conduct research to assess the impact of new or revised legislation on company policies, processes, and operations.
  • Prepare concise summaries and analyses of regulatory updates for internal stakeholders.
  1. Policy Development and Implementation:
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable, and compliant HR policies, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Review and update HR policies, employee handbooks, and compliance documents to ensure continued alignment with legal mandates and organizational standards.
  • Support the implementation and communication of new policies and procedures across the organization.
  1. Compliance Audits and Risk Management:
  • Conduct regular internal reviews of HR processes, records, and systems, including payroll, timekeeping, employee data, and disciplinary actions, to identify compliance gaps and potential risks.
  • Analyze review findings and recommend corrective actions or process improvements to strengthen compliance.
  • Develop and support mitigation strategies to prevent recurring compliance risks.
  1. Advisory and Consultation:
  • Serve as a primary point of contact and subject matter expert for HR and business leaders on labor law and compliance-related inquiries.
  • Provide timely and accurate guidance on employee relations, disciplinary actions, terminations, wages, benefits, leave administration, non-discrimination, and other employment-related matters.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners to ensure practices remain consistent with legal requirements and company policies.
  1. Documentation and Reporting:
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of compliance-related activities, policies, internal reviews, and investigations.
  • Prepare compliance reports for management, highlighting key findings, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Ensure required regulatory filings and reports are completed accurately and on time.
  1. Investigation Support:
  • Support internal investigations related to HR compliance matters, including harassment claims, discrimination allegations, or policy violations, while ensuring fairness and adherence to due process.
  • Assist in gathering evidence, documenting findings, and maintaining investigation records.
  1. Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, Operations, and other departments to enable integrated and consistent compliance practices.
  • Participate in special projects and initiatives that enhance organizational compliance, governance, and operational efficiency.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Law, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or related field.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of progressive experience in HR compliance, labor relations, or employment law-focused HR roles.
  • Legal Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of local labor laws, employment standards, and relevant regulations, including the Philippine Labor Code and related issuances. Familiarity with data privacy and occupational safety and health standards is an advantage.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities to interpret complex legal texts and apply them to practical HR scenarios.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex legal concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy in all work.
  • Ethical Judgment: High level of integrity, discretion, and ethical judgment in handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Proactive and Independent: Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and proactively identify and address compliance issues.
  • Technology Proficiency: Proficient in HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

Applicants should have a current listing as a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) with the state of North Carolina Division of Facility Services and a high school diploma or equivalent is preferred. Additional requirements include:

  • Spot early risks (e.g. clients who seem disengaged or behind on setup) and escalate to relevant stakeholders

  • A natural communicator: warm, structured, and able to put people at ease on a call

  • Comfortable following and adapting a prepared script while keeping the conversation feeling natural

description:

Kia Ora | Hello | Talofa Lava | Ni Hao | Namaste | Mālō e Lelei | Bula Vinaka | Kamusta

About the Role

The Wellness Support Team is seeking a Health Improvement Practitioner to join our award-winning team.

In this innovative primary care role, you will work alongside GPs, nurses, and Health Coaches to deliver brief, evidence-based mental health and wellbeing support, while growing your clinical skills and making a meaningful difference for patients and whānau every day.

As a Health Improvement Practitioner, you will work within the nationally recognised Health Improvement Practitioner (HIP) model, using Focused Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (FACT) to support people experiencing a broad range of mental, physical, behavioural, and social wellbeing concerns. Embedded within the clinic team, you will play a key role in delivering integrated care through warm handovers, timely interventions, and strong multidisciplinary collaboration.

What You Will Do

As a core member of the clinical team, you will:

  • Deliver brief behavioural health interventions within primary care.
  • Support patients and whānau experiencing mental health, addiction, and wellbeing challenges.
  • Work collaboratively with GPs, nurses, Health Coaches, and community providers to deliver coordinated care.
  • Facilitate individual and group-based wellbeing support where appropriate.
  • Support patients to access additional services when required.
  • Maintain clear and accurate clinical documentation.
  • Promote culturally safe practice and equitable health outcomes.

What You Will Bring

To be considered for this role, you will have:

  • A postgraduate qualification enabling therapeutic work with clients.
  • Registration with an appropriate professional body and a current Annual Practising Certificate, or full NZAC membership.
  • At least one year's experience working within a mental health service supporting clients or whānau in a clinical or community setting.
  • Experience delivering brief, evidence-based interventions.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Confidence working within multidisciplinary teams.
  • A commitment to culturally safe practice and equitable health outcomes.
  • The ability to engage effectively with diverse communities across Tāmaki Makaurau.

About the Wellness Support Team

Established in 2012, the Wellness Support Team provides integrated mental health and wellbeing support within primary care settings across Auckland. Our team includes Health Improvement Practitioners, Health Coaches, support workers, and clinical leaders who share a commitment to accessible, person-centred care. Through a stepped-care approach, we help ensure patients and whānau receive the right support at the right time.

The programme has been recognised nationally, receiving the award for Best Mental Health Programme at the New Zealand Primary Healthcare Awards.

What We Offer

  • Ongoing clinical supervision, peer support, and mentoring.
  • Structured induction and continued FACT training.
  • Professional development opportunities and ongoing learning.
  • A collaborative and experienced multidisciplinary team.
  • The opportunity to be part of an innovative and nationally recognised service.
  • Meaningful work that improves access to mental health and wellbeing support for local communities.

Apply Now

If you are looking for a rewarding opportunity to grow your career while making a genuine difference in your community, we'd love to hear from you.

Please include a cover letter with your application.

Applications may be reviewed as they are received, so we encourage early applications.

title: Analytics & AI Developer

About the Role

What if your users could simply ask? We’re building TSIQ, an AI-powered analytics and intelligence platform that answers questions, recommends actions, and runs workflows for the people who use TS Imagine’s Trading, Risk and Prime Brokerage products. As an Analytics & AI Developer you’ll build both the foundation and the intelligence on top of it—the data models, pipelines, and semantic layers that make our data trustworthy, and the AI agents that turn it into answers. You'll be part of our dynamic Data & Analytics Office, a globally distributed, high-impact team that processes trillions of data points and manages our cutting-edge data lake built on Snowflake.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data engineering, semantic modeling, and applied AI—on a product that is being defined as you build it. We have multiple openings across levels, from intermediate through senior.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Data Modelers: You believe a great answer starts with a well-designed model, and you take pride in structuring data so others can trust it.
  • Applied AI Builders: You’re fluent in prompt and context engineering, and you’re energized by making AI agents reliable rather than merely impressive.
  • Analytical Minds: You enjoy delving into complex data sets and ensuring the highest quality for accurate decision-making.
  • Problem Framers: You’re comfortable sitting with a business stakeholder, untangling a vague request, and turning it into something buildable.
  • Storytellers: You're comfortable presenting complex data and AI-driven insights in a way that engages and excites stakeholders.
  • Action Takers: You thrive on challenges, taking ownership of a variety of responsibilities to deliver high-quality results.
  • Lifelong Learners: You're always eager to step outside your comfort zone and dive into the intricacies of one of the most complex business domains.
  • Collaborative Teammates: You possess the technical and interpersonal skills to excel in a cutting-edge software development environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build the data models and pipelines that power TSIQ.
  • Develop semantic models so that AI agents reason over trading, risk, and prime brokerage data with precision and consistency.
  • Build, test, and iterate on AI agents using prompt engineering and context engineering.
  • Implement guardrails, evaluation, and governance controls that keep AI agents accurate, safe, and auditable.
  • Deliver analytics and rapid prototypes in Streamlit to put capabilities in front of users early.
  • Perform business analysis—gather requirements from stakeholders, translate them into technical designs, and validate that what we ship answers the real question.
  • Collaborate with a global team of developers in a fast-paced, innovative setting.

What You Bring

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python, including the ability to contribute to structured, production-grade codebases—not just notebooks.
  • Experience designing data models and building data pipelines, including transformation frameworks such as dbt.
  • Semantic modeling experience—defining metrics, dimensions, and business logic that downstream consumers depend on.
