  • Experience building AI agents and implementing guardrails to govern their behavior (a strong plus).
  • Streamlit or comparable experience building lightweight data applications.
  • Business analysis skills—requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, and documentation.
  • Exceptional communication skills. This role sits between business stakeholders and the platform, so clear written and verbal communication is essential.
  • Capital markets or financial services domain experience. This is extremely important to us—understanding trading, risk, or prime brokerage workflows will set you apart.

Why Join TS Imagine?

  • $1,500 training budget to fuel your growth.

  • Performs decontamination and sterilization using sterilizers, case cart washers, and Automatic Endoscope Reprocessor as assigned.
  • Performs picking of supplies for surgical procedures via case cart system as assigned.
  • Completes and submits appropriate productivity documentation to supervisors daily.
  • Adheres to all regulatory agency requirements (OSHA, FDA, CDC, JCAHO, DOH.) regarding fire/safety, sterilization, universal precautions and good documentation practices (GDP).

Licenses:

ABOUT US

The Center for Human Services (CHS) has provided exceptional opportunities for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities since 1955. SUMMARY

Service coordinators help people meet their personal needs and goals in obtaining the greatest degree of independence and inclusion possible in everyday community life. They help people with developmental disabilities and their families identify and obtain needed services and supports. They also advocate for, monitor, and evaluate services along with the individuals, their families, or guardians.

Linking may involve researching existing resources, developing new resources, making referrals to collaborating agencies with information and follow-up support, preparing Utilization Review requests, service authorizations, and coordinating federal, state, county, and community programs to achieve necessary supports.
  • Ensures quality enhancement by monitoring and assessing the quality, timeliness and effectiveness of services and support received through an ongoing review process. Monitoring occurs via phone or email contact as well as through in person meetings. In person meetings are completed Monthly, Quarterly, and Annually. These meetings can occur in a variety of settings including but not limited to individual’s homes, Day Programs, community settings, an office setting, group homes, and/or residential settings. If there are findings from the monitoring, reporting processes will be followed including protocols for mandated reporting in the case of suspicion of abuse and neglect situations.
  • Make certain documentation is completed via written case note documentation for all activities for each individual within three business days of TCM activity, maintaining a minimum of 120 TCM billable hours per month.

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED MISCELLANEOUS QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must have reliable transportation and an acceptable driving record. Must use your own vehicle for transportation. Must be able to drive for work-related assignments to individuals’ homes to meet face-to-face with individuals on caseloads.

title: Senior Research Specialist-MIB
description:
Market Range: 09

Hiring Salary: $3,946.70 - $5,322.69/Monthly

THIS IS A GRANT FUNDED POSITION FUNDED UNTIL JULY 2030

The Senior Research Specialist assists the Principal Investigator (PI) in the planning, performing, and analyzing of research experiments in a variety of virology and cell biology-based laboratory operations in the Department of Microbiology, Immunology and Biochemistry under the direction of the PI.

  1. Plans and executes molecular virology and cell biology experiments while being experienced in maintaining cell culture.
  2. Performs virus recovery studies (using VSV reverse genetics systems), including the generation of VSV pseudotypes as requested by companies or institutions that have licenses with UTRF.
  3. Conducts cell biology studies (including fluorescence and confocal microscopy analysis, and cell viability experiments).
  4. Carries out assigned experimental procedures and maintains records of established practices and procedures.
  5. Manages chemicals, reagents, supplies, oligonucleotide primers, plasmids or other recombinant DNA, cell lines and bacterial strains in the laboratory.
  6. Consults with PI to organize work schedule and set a comprehensive list of research priorities.
  7. Supervises the ordering of laboratory supplies, contacts distributors and vendors to determine pricing and availability of supplies or equipment, and makes recommendations on the best item to purchase
  8. Assists with the publication of research results.
  9. Performs other related duties, as assigned.

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree. (TRANSCRIPT REQUIRED)

EXPERIENCE: Four (4) years of related laboratory experience; OR Master’s Degree and two (2) years of related laboratory experience. Must have experience with non-segmented, negative-sense RNA virus reverse genetics, and working in a BSL-2 laboratory. Prior experience with virology and molecular biology techniques to generate VSV pseudoviruses; experience in fluorescence microscopy, excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills are essential.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Skill with virology and molecular biology techniques.
  • Knowledge and ability to generate a pseudovirus using the Delta-G VSV system.
  • Ability to perform fluorescence microscopy.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

WORK SCHEDULE: This position may occasionally be required to work evenings and weekends.

title: Americas Logistics Readiness Program Manager
description:
Imagine what you could accomplish at Apple. In an environment where innovation and operational excellence thrive, we're seeking a highly organized, strategic thinker to lead logistics readiness, program management, and supply chain execution across the Americas region. This role sits at the heart of Apple's Americas logistics operations and owns both strategic and tactical planning across distribution centers, transportation networks, and cross-functional delivery programs — transforming complex operational challenges into clear, measurable business impact with creativity, rigor, and a bias for action.

You will play a critical role in ensuring the seamless and efficient movement of products and materials across the Americas region, owning logistics readiness planning and coordination across distribution centers and transportation networks. Driven by a commitment to operational excellence, you will develop strategies and program frameworks that enable informed, proactive decision-making — improving service, cost, and delivery performance while leading logistics readiness from strategy through execution. This role drives cross-functional alignment across supply chain, operations, sales, and channel partners to ensure service, cost, and operational efficiency, while managing program budget, timelines, resources, and deliverables. You will evaluate supply chain risks and implement contingency plans to mitigate impact — including ad-hoc analytical problem solving during dynamic or unprecedented events — partnering with stakeholders to translate complex requirements into actionable logistics plans that drive alignment and effective execution. You will identify process improvement and change management opportunities across tools, workstreams, and systems — driving solutions from conception through implementation, directly or through partner teams. You will build automation that improves team efficiency, monitor KPIs to identify improvement opportunities, and standardize cadences to improve planning quality and speed. Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, structured problem-solving, and strategic leadership — the ability to turn complex operational data into clear decisions, facilitate cross-functional programs, and communicate findings in relatable terms that highlight business impact and guide strategic choices for senior leadership. You will navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while serving as a trusted subject matter expert across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in logistics operations, supply chain, and program management, preferably in the technology industry
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous operational problems, build analytical models, and translate outputs into decisions
  • Strong knowledge of transportation and distribution processes, with experience managing complex logistics programs end-to-end
  • Fluency with analytical tools and BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MS or MBA) preferred
  • Experience collaborating with 3PL partners, carriers, and internal stakeholders to optimize network performance
  • Automation, process improvement, and continuous improvement experience (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent)
  • Experience with AI-assisted tools (LLMs, GenAI assistants) to accelerate analysis and reporting
  • Proven ability to influence and drive strategic change in a fast-paced, matrixed organization
  • Comfortable diving deep into complex datasets to drive actionable decisions
  • Leadership presence to inspire teams, foster collaboration, and deliver measurable impact
  • Strong executive communication and leadership skills, including presenting assumptions, scenarios, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Ability to drive decisions in a fast-paced environment; resilient and adaptable, thriving in ambiguity and high-pressure settings

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Functions:

Incoming Materials Quality Assurance
Define and maintain incoming inspection criteria and control plans.
Verify that raw materials and components meet technical and quality specifications.
Coordinate inspections, testing, and validation of incoming goods
Manage non-conforming materials, including segregation, documentation, and disposition.
Support supplier quality improvement initiatives and follow up on corrective actions.
Prepare reports on incoming defects, in-process quality performance, and corrective actions.
Manufacturing Process Quality Assurance
Develop and implement process FMEA & quality control plans.
Monitor and audit manufacturing processes to ensure compliance with standards.
Apply statistical process control (SPC) to track process stability and capability.
Identify process deviations and lead corrective/preventive actions
Lead root cause analysis using methodologies such as 8D, 5Why, Ishikawa.
Ensure proper use of quality tools (Poka-Yoke, visual controls, mistake-proofing).
Implement the initiatives to reduce scrap, rework, Customers claims and cost of poor quality (COPQ).
Ensure compliance with quality management systems (ISO 9001 and applicable product certifications).
Support internal certification audits.
Ensure traceability and proper recordkeeping of inspections and test results.

Requirements:

  • 3–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Industrial, Electrical, Manufacturing, or related field).
  • Experience in both incoming inspection and manufacturing process control.
    Knowledge of quality tools: APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans.
    Familiarity with metrology and inspection techniques.
    Experience with ERP/SAP systems and quality software.

title: Director, Revenue Cycle Management Customer Experience
description:
In this high-impact leadership role, you will lead the strategic integration of our currently separate Patient-facing and Client-facing contact centers into a single, unified Omnichannel Shared Services organization.

This organizational synthesis is a critical component of our enterprise-wide migration to a new unified Electronic Health Record (EHR) ecosystem. You will serve as the primary Revenue Cycle Management Customer Service architect for our upcoming deployment of Epic. You will lead the migration to an integrated enterprise cloud telephony platform and deploy a scalable, remote organizational model. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in laboratory or healthcare revenue cycle operations, a proven track record of breaking down operational silos to stand up centralized shared service environments, and mastery in using advanced digital communication tools to cultivate a high-performance culture across distributed virtual teams.

This is a remote position and will require up to 25% travel.

Responsibilities

Strategic Transformation & Shared Services Migration

  • Integrated Centralization Roadmap: Design and execute the master strategy to merge separate patient and client billing desks, customer service teams, and regional vendor footprints into a single, cohesive national RCM Shared Services model.
  • EHR Alignment Strategy: Harmonize patient-facing billing workflows and business-to-business (client/provider) billing paths under a single management umbrella, synchronizing the consolidation with the enterprise-wide transition to the new EHR ledger.
  • Virtual Transition Governance: Oversee the migration phases to guarantee zero disruption to client and patient collections and cash flow metrics, while minimizing patient and client friction.
  • Change Management: Serve as the RCM Service change agent across the enterprise, aligning cross-functional stakeholders (Operations, IT, Compliance, Finance) on performance standards, service tiering, and digital-first operational governance.

Epic Ecosystem & Omnichannel Technology Integration

  • Epic Cheers Alignment: Lead the strategic design and deployment of Epic Cheers to manage proactive patient outreach, digital billing campaigns, and conversational chat/SMS interactions. Ensure Cheers acts as the foundational engagement engine driving self-service and payment plan adoption.
  • Epic Resolute Workflow Integration: Partner with the Epic revenue cycle implementation team to align Cheers engagement histories with Epic Resolute (Hospital Billing/Professional Billing) workflows. Ensure seamless data exchange between laboratory information systems (LIS) and financial ledgers.
  • Enterprise Cloud Telephony Integration: Lead the business integration of an advanced Cloud Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform with the Epic ecosystem. Maximize the use of Epic Cheers embedded communication controls to deliver a single-pane-of-glass interface for remote agents, minimizing after-call work (ACW) and screen-toggling delays.

Remote Organizational Design & Capacity Modeling

  • Cross-Functional Organizational Modeling: Design intelligent skill-based routing pathways to handle distinct client accounts alongside direct patient inquiries. Clear tiering structures must balance transactional inquiries against complex, multi-line corporate laboratory accounts.
  • Distributed Workforce Management (WFM): Establish robust, variable capacity-planning models and exact staffing ratios based on national call volumes, digital concurrency targets, and cyclical volume spikes (such as high-deductible resets in Q1) across multiple time zones.
  • Remote Culture & Talent Framework: Collaborate with HR to build contemporary job profiles, skill-based routing rubrics, career ladders, and performance-incentive programs tailored for a remote workforce. Establish virtual engagement frameworks to combat isolation and drive retention.

Execution, Security & Rollout Strategy

  • Phased Deployment Plan: Formulate and manage a disciplined, multi-phase rollout schedule that aligns with the enterprise implementation strategy, ensuring agent readiness and staffing adequacy.
  • Remote Security & Compliance Guardrails: Author comprehensive operational playbooks detailing unified Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), job aides and reference materials ensuring agent readiness and skill mastery.

Required:

title: Coordinator, Staffing
description:
Your experience matters

Woodland Springs is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As a Staffing Coordinator joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

More about our team

Our philosophy is built on a psychosocial model of care to decrease suicide rates, decrease addiction-related deaths, reverse the decline in life expectancy, and improve productivity in the communities we serve. We offer a collaborative work environment, competitive compensation, and flexible scheduling so you can focus on what really matters–providing quality patient care. Join our team in Conroe, Texas, to build a career that touches lives.

How you’ll contribute

A Staffing Coordinator who excels in this role performs a variety of duties to support nursing administration. Reviews staffing needs daily, calculating staffing requirements based on flexible staffing patterns and patient acuity and maintains record of reports.

  • Supervises Patient Sitters.

    Provides recruitment, direction, orientation, training, coaching, and mentoring to Patient Sitters.

  • Assesses and ensures quality of services delivered and facilitates staff development programs.
  • Ensures staff compliance with departmental and organizational policies, procedures, and protocols.
  • Composes, types, and transcribes correspondence, forms, reports, presentation materials and other written communications.
  • Receives, screens, and routes visitors and telephone calls. Responds to, escalates, and follows up on inquiries and problems as appropriate.
  • Schedules/coordinates meetings, conferences, special events, and appointments.
  • Maintains assigned calendar(s).
  • Maintains files and office equipment.
  • Orders and stocks supplies.
  • Additional duties as assigned and needed.

  • Requires critical thinking skills, decisive judgment and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

  • Must be able to work in a stressful environment and take appropriate action.

  • Education: Required: High school diploma or equivalent; Associate degree preferred.

  • CPR certification and Crisis Prevention Training (CPI) within 30 days of employment prior to any patient contact

Schedule: 5x8, Days, rotating weekends

Why join us

People are our passion and purpose. Come work where you are appreciated for who you are not just what you can do.

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Multiple levels of medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time employees.

  • Financial Protection & PTO: Life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid family leave and paid time off.

  • Financial & Career Growth: Higher education and certification tuition assistance, loan assistance and 401(k) retirement package and company match.

  • Employee Well-being: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs).

Professional Development: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

More about Woodland Springs

Woodland Springs is a behavioral health hospital located in Conroe, Texas. We provide inpatient and outpatient programming for those facing mental health and addiction challenges. Our programs offer caring, compassionate treatment for children, adolescents, adults, and seniors.

Programs include inpatient mental health and addiction treatment, Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP), Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP), and Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT).

Full-Time - 0.9 FTE/72 Hours Biweekly

Rotating 0700-1900; 1900-0700

Every 3rd Weekend; 1 Major, 1 Minor and 1 Split Holiday

General Summary

Provides staff/professional development expertise as an educator, consultant, facilitator, change agent and leader. Supports the development of bedside nursing staff and fosters empowerment through knowledge and delivery of evidence-based nursing practices and care. This occurs through the facilitation of the educational process through assessment, development, planning, implementation and evaluation of competency assessment, continuing education, and leadership development. Possesses the ability to convey and deliver information thoroughly and effectively using a variety of styles and techniques.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Participates and collaborates in the annual development of an education/learning needs assessment for the department of nursing.
  • Conducts learning needs assessment using a variety of strategic tools. Provides educational programs and curricula for nursing staff as identified from education/learning needs assessment. Programs/curricula may be unit-based education or department of nursing-based education. Track measurable outcomes related to improved patient outcomes as a result of knowledge gained from education.
  • Assists in the development, implementation, and validation of department of nursing competencies for varied roles: RN’s, NA’s, technicians, and unit secretary’s as applicable for each department.
  • Assists with house wide or department of nursing orientation of new equipment, updates to Joint Commission, National Patient Safety Goals (NPSG) requirements and other topics as necessary.
  • Teaches content as needed/or assigned within clinical expertise to facilitate orientation, staff development, and/or safe clinical practice.
  • Assists nursing staff in developing and designing programs of study specific to the patient population served.
  • Meets with preceptors and orientees on a regular basis to monitor orientation progress and assist in setting goals for orientee in collaboration with unit-based preceptor and nurse manager. Verifies orientation content is appropriate for achieving role independence.
  • Acts as a liaison between the new employee and hospital to facilitate the socialization process into the new unit and work culture.
  • Routinely meets with Nurse Managers to identify staff or unit educational needs. Develops/revises educational plan(s) accordingly to assure ongoing competency and validation of professional nursing practice.
  • Supports direct care delivery and consultations as needed and/or as requested by unit managers.
  • Assists with tracking staff education requirements and facilitate/mentor staff in meeting unit and department of nursing requirements.
  • Promotes evidence-based practice and nursing research and actively seeks opportunities for staff to participate in these activities on the unit/department/system.
  • Supports and promotes specialty certification of staff, and provides education as needed.

Common Expectations:

  • Maintains established policies and procedures, objectives, quality assessment, safety, environmental and infection control standards.
  • Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs, current literature, in-service meetings, professional organizations and workshops.
  • Provides outstanding service to all customers; fosters teamwork; and practices fiscal responsibility through improvement and innovation.
  • Educational consultant for unit/department to facilitate task forces, committees, councils, and projects relating to policy, procedure and program development.
  • Responds to organizational mandates, management of sentinel events and promotion of quality of patient care to support superior clinical outcomes, nursing care and patient safety.
  • Supports shared decision-making structure at both the unit, entity and system levels through active involvement as appropriate and encouraging staff professional development.

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelors Degree Required
  • Masters Degree Preferred

Work Experience:

  • 3 years In acute care setting or area of specialty. Required
  • Previous teaching experience; teaching and learning strategies, learning styles, curriculum and design. Preferred

Licenses:

  • Licensed Registered Nurse Upon Hire Required or
  • Registered Nurse Multi State License Upon Hire Required and
  • Basic Life Support Upon Hire Required

Courses and Training:

  • Professional nursing certification in area of clinical specialty/professional development/nursing education. Upon Hire Preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Substantial computer literacy and data file management skills.
  • Knowledge of regulatory standards, both national and state.
  • Demonstrated experience in preparing for and handling state and federal surveys would be an advantage.

Benefits Offered:

  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Education assistance
  • Financial education and support, including DailyPay
  • Expanded Paid Parental Leave

For additional details: Benefits & Incentives | WellSpan Careers (joinwellspan.org)

title: Dermatologist - HealthPartners Specialty Center, St Paul, MN
description:
Dermatologist

HealthPartners Specialty Center – St Paul, MN

Enjoy a 4-day work week with the advantage of a large department and an integrated multi-specialty group practice. Part-time opportunities available as well. Highly competitive salary based on a productivity system as well as an exceptional benefits package.

You will be joining a team that is supportive and respectful of one another and deeply committed to the mission of HealthPartners. title: SCHOOL BASED ABA THERAPIST
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: School-based ABA providers deliver evidence-based Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services designed to support children and adolescents in developing meaningful skills across social, emotional, behavioral, communication, and academic settings. ABA providers work collaboratively within school environments and alongside families, educators, and clinical teams to help students reach individualized goals and improve overall quality of life.

Providers will implement individualized behavior support plans, collect data, support skill development, and utilize positive reinforcement strategies to promote independence and success for students with autism spectrum disorder, developmental disabilities, and other behavioral needs.

MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide direct ABA services to children and adolescents in school-based settings
  • Implement individualized treatment plans and behavior intervention strategies developed by the clinical team
  • Support students in developing communication, social, adaptive, emotional regulation, and daily living skills
  • Utilize evidence-based ABA principles and positive behavior supports
  • Collect accurate data and document student progress during sessions
  • Establish positive, trusting relationships with students, families, and school personnel
  • Collaborate with Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs), therapists, teachers, and caregivers to support student goals
  • Assist in identifying barriers impacting student success and implement appropriate interventions
  • Support classroom participation, transitions, routines, and skill generalization across environments
  • Provide caregiver education and support when appropriate
  • Maintain confidentiality and follow all ethical and professional standards
  • Complete required documentation including session notes, data collection, and progress updates
  • Participate in clinical supervision, team meetings, trainings, and professional development opportunities
  • Assist with community outreach and organizational initiatives as needed

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Education: Bachelor’s Degree

EXPERIENCE: 1 Year

MANAGES OTHERS: N

EMPLOYMENT STATUS:

Part-time

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, education, social work, behavioral health, or related field preferred
  • Experience working with children and/or individuals with autism, developmental disabilities, or behavioral needs preferred
  • Experience implementing behavioral interventions or skill-building programs preferred
  • Knowledge of Applied Behavior Analysis principles preferred
  • Ability to complete required training and maintain applicable certifications (such as RBT, if applicable)

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to successfully pass required background checks and employment screenings
  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries and confidentiality
  • Reliable transportation and willingness to travel between school/community locations as needed
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams
  • Commitment to providing inclusive, compassionate, and individualized support to youth

OTHER SKILLS:

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Patient, compassionate, and supportive approach when working with children and families
  • Ability to build positive relationships and establish trust
  • Strong observation and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to follow individualized treatment plans and collect accurate data
  • Organized with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to changing environments and student needs
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team
  • Passion for supporting children and advancing within the behavioral health field

description:

title: Chatroom Operator
description:
Who are we?

We are Drips. The founders of conversational texting ® and Americas leading automated humanized texting platform for brands to hold conversations at scale with their consumers.

In a world where no one answers calls anymore, Drips is answering a real need in the market for companies and their consumers.

What’s the job?

We are looking to expand our work from home conversation improvement team. Every day Drips holds millions of automated humanized conversations for our clients, but automation isn’t enough, and Artificial Intelligence (“A.I.”) isn’t perfect. We hold the highest industry standard of excellence in staying “humanized” and if our natural language processor is not 98% sure what a user is asking, we will rely on you and your teammates to read a consumer's response, respond contextually, and categorize it appropriately.

Example:
A user says, “Cant now, werkin”. This would be categorized and handled by clicking the “I’m at work.” button.

You must be able to maintain a 97%+ accuracy in your responses that will be randomly audited and quality assured. Your work and responses will help inform our natural language model therefore your accuracy is of the utmost importance.

Compensation:

$10-$13/hour, part-time (up to 27 hours/week)

Training:

This is a work from home opportunity, training will be held via Zoom video call.

Hours:

We are looking for multiple shifts to fill this role and are willing to work around schedules. Must be able to work 6 straight hours/day, 3-5 days/week (Monday-Sunday).

Schedules available:
9am-3pm
11am-5pm
4pm-10pm

Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities:

  • Quickly and accurately (in less than 60 seconds) respond to inbound messages via our chat room to consumers regarding questions or concerns around the product or service utilizing point and click frequently asked questions canned responses.
  • Keep conversations contextual and on track. Example: if someone says they are sick you would click the “Can’t talk/bad news” button that empathizes with them but still prompts to schedule a time to handle their request.
  • Maintain 97% or above accuracy in response handling

Skills/Qualifications:

  • Exceptional attention to detail, high standard of excellence/perfection
  • Comfortability on a computer, proficient typing skills (can’t hunt and peck)
  • Proficient in emojis (this isn’t a joke, our users use emojis)
  • Good grammatical, spelling, and logic skills.
  • Exceptional verbal, communication, and written skills.
  • Reliable and responsible to a designated schedule.
  • Must have reliable internet/wifi, and a computer with up-to-date software.

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Event Streaming Platform (Kafka)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join Event Streaming team — the distributed team responsible for the Kafka infrastructure and event streaming systems that power business-critical workflows across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.

You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of Platform Engineering and Reliability Engineering, building and running the streaming backbone that is used by thousands of services across 3 companies. This is deeply technical work: you'll own distributed systems at scale, contribute to long-term architecture decisions, and be working on the reliability of critical parts of infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, in-house Event Streaming abstraction (internally called Event Bus) and any future streaming platform technologies. These systems support critical workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale, event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, Event Bus and related streaming components.
  • Debug complex distributed systems issues — latency issues, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, partition imbalances — and drive them to resolution.
  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.
  • Contribute to the team's 24/7 On-call rotation and incident response, and drive continuous improvement through pre-mortems, operational readiness checklists and post-mortem action items.

title: Senior Ecommerce Executive | Lookfantastic
description:
About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.

Why be a Senior Ecommerce Executive at THG Beauty?

Operates at a more senior level than Ecommerce Executive, owning relationships and providing direction. Thorough skills across data analysis, SQL and manipulating data. Understands the 'why' behind actions, not just the fact we are actioning them.

As Senior Ecommerce Executive you’ll:

  • Systems: lead training and learning on TeePee, Superset, Tableau, ContentSquare, Campaign Manager and GA; manipulate SQL independently.
  • Offers: independently set up all offer types; act as a point of contact for other team members requiring support.
  • KPIs: proactively suggest and take actions to influence Revenue, GP, AOV, CVR & Traffic.
  • Site Execution: set an example in the use of systems to understand and enhance the customer journey from a trade perspective; competently use CSQ (Zoning, Journey, Workspace analysis).
  • GP: own the 'why' behind trade actions; drive GP-focused decisions with greater autonomy.
  • Cross channel/function collaboration: drive trading actions with greater autonomy. Ownership of multiple categories/channels.
  • Change Management: understand business needs and priorities; help lead the redistribution of workload across the team to hit deadlines.
  • Ownerships: thorough understanding of individual and team roles; drive own areas and support others with theirs.
  • Knowledge Sharing: set an example in how knowledge and insight is shared across and outside the team

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

  • Prioritisation: independently prioritise workload; support team members to do the same.
  • Organisation: independently manage own workload; support others to organise theirs.
  • Collaboration: lead collaboration across and outside the team; drive process improvements.
  • Communication: strong written/verbal communication, flexed for the audience and division.
  • Active Listening: lead by example in meetings.
  • Growth Mindset: proactively identify and close gaps in own knowledge.
  • Accountability: strong attention to detail in own work.
  • Role Model: demonstrate leadership across the Executive level within the team.

What’s in it for me?

Career Development

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year.
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

Wellbeing Support

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.
  • Access to our on-site physio.

Other Perks

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.

  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.

  • On-site staff shop.

  • Conduct comprehensive hearing assessments and recommend appropriate solutions.

The individual will operate at the intersection of banking domain expertise and data, analytics and AI advisory, engaging senior business and technology stakeholders on challenges spanning customer analytics, credit risk, fraud, collections, and data infrastructure etc. This is not a transactional sales role; the ideal candidate is a trusted advisor who brings genuine domain and analytics credibility to every client interaction.

Working closely with EXL's delivery leads, analytics solution teams, and practice leaders, the Senior AVP will own the account growth agenda, shape new opportunities, and ensure EXL is consistently positioned as a strategic partner.

Strategic Account Management

  • Own the end-to-end client relationship for a major strategic banking account, serving as EXL's primary senior point of contact.
  • Develop and execute a multi-year account growth plan aligned to the client's data, analytics, and operational priorities.
  • Drive expansion across buying centers including Risk, Marketing, Technology, Operations, Compliance, and Finance within the client organization.
  • Maintain a strong pulse on client satisfaction, delivery performance, and renewal risk; proactively address issues before they escalate.

Banking Domain Advisory

  • Advise client stakeholders on data management and analytics strategies across the full consumer lending lifecycle: acquisition, activation, usage, line management, retention, and attrition.
  • Bring an informed perspective on credit card lending program analytics, including partner data integration, cardholder segmentation, and program P&L optimization.
  • Engage credibly on credit risk topics: application scoring, behavioral risk, line management, account management strategies, and stress testing.
  • Contribute meaningfully to client conversations on fraud analytics, disputes management, regulatory analytics (CFPB, fair lending, Reg Z), and collections optimization.

Data Management & Analytics Opportunity Development

  • Identify and shape opportunities for EXL's data management capabilities, including data governance, data quality, cloud platform modernization, and reporting infrastructure.
  • Translate client business priorities into analytics use cases: propensity models, next-best-action engines, customer lifetime value, real-time fraud scoring, delinquency prediction, and digital engagement analytics.
  • Partner with EXL's analytics, AI, and technology solution teams to develop compelling proposals, proof-of-concepts, and business cases tailored to the client's environment.
  • Stay current on the client's technology landscape and data ecosystem to identify integration points and accelerate solution deployment.

Revenue Growth & Pipeline Management

  • Own the account revenue target and actively manage a pipeline of new opportunities across analytics, data management, AI/ML, and operations.
  • Lead or coordinate RFP responses, solution presentations, commercial negotiations, and contract renewals.
  • Identify and execute cross-sell and upsell opportunities across EXL's service portfolio.
  • Provide accurate, timely pipeline reporting and account status updates to EXL leadership.

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

  • Represent EXL's banking data and analytics capabilities in executive client meetings, industry conferences, and client-facing engagements.
  • Contribute to EXL's perspective on consumer lending and analytics trends, including AI-driven enterprise developments.
  • Mentor and guide junior account team members; help build EXL's client management capabilities over time..
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in consumer lending or financial services, with meaningful exposure to data management, analytics, or technology-led transformation.
  • Deep understanding of U.S. consumer lending business models, including co-branded and partnership programs, issuer economics, and full portfolio lifecycle management.
  • Track record of managing and growing strategic client relationships, preferably in a consulting, analytics services, or BPO/ITO context.
  • Hands-on or advisory experience in lending analytics: customer acquisition modeling, credit risk and scoring strategies, behavioral analytics, fraud detection, collections scoring, or campaign analytics.
  • Solid grasp of data management concepts: data governance, data quality, cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/Azure/GCP), and analytics engineering.
  • Experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders across Risk, Marketing, Technology, and Operations functions at` large financial institutions.
  • Ability to translate business problems into analytics and technology solution narratives, comfortable in both executive and technical conversations.

  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

    Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree in Analytics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred.
  • Based in New York area.

  • Willingness to travel to client sites as required.

    Ideal Candidate Profile

  • The ideal candidate has spent their career at the intersection of consumer lending and data and analytics, whether inside a financial institution, at a consulting firm serving banking clients, or within a data and analytics services organization. They understand how financial institutions are run, how decisions get made, and where data and analytics create real competitive advantage.

  • This person does not need to be a technologist but must be analytically credible. They bring a genuine perspective on where analytics, AI and data management are taking the consumer lending business and can articulate EXL's role in that journey with confidence and specificity.

title: Scheduler
description:
Summary

The Project Scheduler develops and maintains software schedules for all assigned construction projects within the strategic business unit(s). This role monitors schedule progression against the baseline, explains schedule variances, and prepares reports on schedule-related trends. The Project Scheduler assists the project team in understanding each project’s outlook and develops scheduling standards and procedures.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain schedules for assigned projects utilizing Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling techniques.
  • Organize and prioritize incoming bid proposals to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Review project schedule data, including activity records, actual start/finish dates, costs/budgets, work breakdown structures, and related activity data.
  • Evaluate work packages and related data for feasibility of implementation; recommend alternative methods or processes to efficiently achieve and maintain desired results.
  • Interface with internal and external customers to communicate work status and any corrective actions required to ensure conformance to established schedules.
  • Collaborate closely with the preconstruction team (project managers, superintendents, project engineers, estimators) to ensure schedule information is clearly communicated to those performing the work.
  • Analyze project requirements with the project team and ensure required resources are available to maintain established schedules; notify supervision and project team of resource constraints as needed.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain status updates on project activities and milestones.
  • Coordinate projects with all participants to ensure plans are achievable and current on a daily basis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or equivalent experience.
  • Experience managing scheduling for commercial construction projects.
  • Five (5+) years of experience or equivalent specialized training and work experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of Primavera P6 scheduling software and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, handle a large workload, and prioritize effectively to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to independently apply advanced analysis techniques and demonstrate experience overseeing construction processes while leading others in complex, interrelated tasks.
  • Knowledge of various construction industry markets (e.g., institutional, retail, government, hospitality, healthcare).
  • Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and coordinate team members effectively.
  • High integrity; maintains ethical standards, professional conduct, and organizational policies.
  • Proficient in operating standard office equipment (computer, printer, phone, copier, etc.).
  • Strong written, verbal, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Excellent knowledge of construction practices, methods, trends, and crew data.
  • Ability to perform essential duties efficiently, accurately, and safely, with or without reasonable accommodation.

The full salary range for this position is $100,000 to $125,000. This position is eligible for a target bonus.

description:
Counsellor - Bank

Help Transform Lives Through Recovery

Providence Projects, part of UK Addiction Treatment Group (UKAT), provides specialist residential treatment and support for people experiencing drug and alcohol addiction.

We are looking for a compassionate and motivated Counsellor - Bank to join our multidisciplinary team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who holds a Level 4 counselling qualification. You will support clients throughout their recovery journey, helping them understand the underlying causes of addiction, develop effective coping strategies and build the confidence needed to achieve lasting change.

About the Role

As a Counsellor - Bank, you will work closely with support workers and other members of the team to deliver safe, person-centred and recovery-focused support.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Providing individual counselling and structured therapeutic support to clients.
  • Supporting the delivery of group sessions, workshops and recovery activities.
  • Helping clients explore behaviours, emotions and experiences linked to addiction.
  • Maintaining clear, accurate and confidential client records.
  • Contributing to individual care plans, risk assessments and treatment reviews.
  • Working collaboratively with the wider clinical and operational teams.
  • Supporting clients to develop relapse-prevention strategies and sustainable recovery plans.
  • Maintaining appropriate professional boundaries and following safeguarding procedures.
  • Administering and recording medication in line with organisational policies, procedures and training.
  • Support clients with travel to medical appointment and meetings
  • Participating in the on-call rota with the wider team to provide appropriate support and guidance outside normal working hours when required (after completion of induction period).
  • Participating in supervision, training and continued professional development.

About You

We are looking for someone who is empathetic, resilient and committed to supporting people through recovery.

You will need:

  • A Level 4 counselling qualification.
  • An understanding of counselling theory, ethical practice and professional boundaries.
  • The ability to communicate sensitively and effectively with clients who may have complex needs.
  • Full UK Driving licence with access to own vehicle and business insurance (business Insurance contribution can be arranged).
  • Strong listening, relationship-building and record-keeping skills.
  • The ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • A non-judgmental and person-centred approach.
  • An understanding of safeguarding, confidentiality and risk management.
  • The willingness and ability to undertake medication administration training and follow medication-management procedures.
  • The flexibility and willingness to participate in the on-call rota.
  • An understanding of addiction treatment, mental health or trauma-informed care.

Desirable:

  • You are working towards or hold Full membership to the BACP or NCPS, you are visible on the public register or a member of Addiction Professionals “Practioner”

Previous experience within addiction treatment, 12 step recovery such as Alcoholics Anonymous and Narcotics Anonymous, mental health, residential care or a similar setting would be advantageous, but we also welcome applications from candidates looking to develop their counselling career within a supportive clinical environment.


Our Values

Our values guide how we support our clients and work with one another:

Understanding – We listen, show empathy and recognise each person’s individual journey.

Kindness – We treat everyone with compassion, dignity and respect.

Accountability – We take responsibility for our actions and maintain high professional standards.

Teamwork – We work collaboratively to achieve the best outcomes for our clients.


What We Offer

  • A supportive and experienced multidisciplinary team.
  • Regular supervision and opportunities for professional development.
  • The opportunity to build experience within specialist addiction treatment.
  • Training and development opportunities.
  • Employee wellbeing support.
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful difference to people’s lives.
  • Contribution towards Business Insurance (car)

The successful candidate will be required to complete appropriate pre-employment checks, including references, proof of right to work in the UK and an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service check.

UKAT is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of the people who use our services. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace.

Apply today and help support our clients as they take the next steps towards lasting recovery.

title: General Practitioner | White Cross Shirley | Christchurch
description:
General Practitioner

Location: White Cross Shirley, Christchurch
Hours: 24 Hours Per Week

About the Role

We are seeking a General Practitioner to join our experienced and supportive team at White Cross Shirley.

This is an excellent opportunity for a General Practitioner looking for genuine flexibility and work-life balance while continuing to provide high-quality, patient-centred care. Working 24 hours per week, you will enjoy the benefits of a part-time schedule while being part of a well-established clinic that values collaboration, continuity of care, and strong community connections.

White Cross Shirley serves a diverse patient population and offers a rewarding scope of practice where you can build meaningful, long-term relationships with patients and their families. As a frontline healthcare provider, you will play an important role in delivering accessible primary care, helping patients receive the right care at the right time while reducing avoidable hospital presentations and easing pressure on secondary healthcare services.

Supported by experienced nurses, efficient systems, and a dedicated administration team, you will be able to focus on what matters most, delivering excellent patient care.

What You Will Do

As a valued member of the clinical team, you will:

  • Deliver high-quality, patient-centred general practice care.
  • Assess, diagnose, and manage acute and long-term health conditions.
  • Develop meaningful and lasting relationships with patients and their families.
  • Promote preventative healthcare and support positive health outcomes.
  • Work collaboratively with nursing and multidisciplinary teams to provide coordinated care.
  • Support continuity of care through proactive patient management and follow-up.
  • Contribute to reducing avoidable hospital admissions through accessible community-based healthcare.
  • Maintain accurate clinical records and documentation in accordance with professional standards.
  • Participate in a supportive, team-based approach focused on delivering positive patient outcomes.

What You Will Bring

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Registration with the Medical Council of New Zealand and a current Annual Practising Certificate, or eligibility for registration.
  • Experience working as a General Practitioner within primary care.
  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and decision-making skills.
  • A commitment to delivering culturally safe, patient-centred healthcare.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A collaborative approach and passion for working within multidisciplinary teams.
  • A genuine desire to improve health outcomes for individuals, families, and the wider community.

About White Cross Shirley

White Cross Shirley is a well-equipped, community-focused clinic with a strong reputation for delivering accessible and high-quality healthcare. With a steady and diverse patient base, the clinic offers the opportunity to build meaningful ongoing relationships while working within a supportive and experienced clinical team.

The clinic provides a broad range of services, and there is flexibility to continue developing areas of clinical interest, including skin procedures, women's health, and other specialist interests. Whether you already enjoy procedural work or are looking to broaden your scope, there is support to help you develop your practice over time.

As part of the Tamaki Health network, you will benefit from access to clinical leadership, operational support, professional development opportunities, and a wider network of healthcare professionals.

To learn more about the clinic, visit:

What We Offer

  • A flexible part-time position working 24 hours per week.
  • Minimal weekend commitments, with no more than one shift per month at our after-hours provider, Riccarton Clinic.
  • The option to expand into a full-time multi-site roster if desired.
  • Contractor or salaried employment options.
  • Strong nursing, clinical, and administrative support.
  • Efficient systems and processes that allow you to focus on patient care.
  • The opportunity to develop and grow your clinical interests.
  • Professional development and career opportunities across the Tamaki Health network.
  • A supportive and collaborative team environment where your wellbeing is valued.

Apply Now

If you are looking for a General Practice role that offers flexibility, strong clinical support, and the opportunity to make a genuine difference within a well-established community, we would love to hear from you.

If you would like to have an initial confidential discussion before applying for the role, please contact Sona at 027 321 2701 or email at sona.sharifi@tamakihealth.co.nz.

title: Dir, Labor Relations and HR Policy
description:
The Director, Labor Relations and Human Resources (HR) Policy serves as a strategic leader and subject matter expert on labor relations with an enterprise-wide scope. This role is responsible for leading labor negotiations, interpreting, and ensuring the consistent and effective administration of collective bargaining agreements and grievance procedures and fostering constructive union relationships. The Director will also lead and drive positive employee relations initiatives and will provide critical and expert guidance and consulting on the labor relations impact of business decisions and transactions, helping to proactively manage risk and align labor strategy with operational goals.

The Director will be responsible for ensuring that the HR policies and procedures are reviewed and maintained and will establish or review the appropriate governance.

This role may work remotely but prefer close to Quest site.

National base range $170,000 - $200,000 but actual compensation dependent on location + 20% AIP.

Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. Successful candidates may be eligible to receive annual performance bonus compensation.


Benefits Information: We are proud to offer best-in-class benefits and programs to support employees and their families in living healthy, happy lives. Our pay and benefit plans have been designed to promote employee health in all respects – physical, financial, and developmental. Depending on whether it is a part-time or full-time position, some of the benefits offered may include:

  • Day 1 Medical, supplemental health, dental & vision for FT employees who work 30+ hours
  • Best-in-class well-being programs
  • Annual, no-cost health assessment program Blueprint for Wellness®
  • healthyMINDS mental health program
  • Vacation and Health/Flex Time
  • 6 Holidays plus 1 "MyDay" off
  • FinFit financial coaching and services
  • 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth IRA with company match up to 5% after 12 months of service
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Life and disability insurance, plus buy-up option
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Annual incentive plans
  • Matching gifts program
  • Education assistance through MyQuest for Education
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • …and so much more!

Duties and Responsibilities

The Director will be part of the Employee Relations COE leadership team and will focus on the following key areas:

Labor Relations

  • Oversee and execute the long-term operational strategy, policy, methodology and management of the Labor Relations services, subject to management guidance and approval.

  • Prepare collective bargaining agreement negotiation strategies, lead and conduct negotiations, and perform tasks necessary to finalize signed agreements.

  • Ensure adequate support for integration of acquisitions with respect to the Labor Relations processes and policies, including due diligence and integration.

  • Engage with legal, operations, and other stakeholders to monitor and ensure appropriate conduct of campaigns, elections, or other recognition processes.

  • Lead or support union campaigns and concerted activity events (e.g., union card signing, strikes, employee petitions, etc.) as they arise.

  • Assist and support labor contract administration to include grievance resolution and arbitration advocacy, among other related tasks.

  • Review and evaluate collective bargaining agreements, provide analysis, identify risks, and develop solutions to mitigate risk and support operations.

  • Develop, foster, and maintain constructive union relationships.

Positive Employee Relations

  • Lead and support Positive Employee Relations efforts across Quest Diagnostics, including planning and execution of nationwide team projects and initiatives.

  • Develop and maintain a positive ER training curriculum and programs to further develop HR & People leaders.

  • Conduct local / regional climate assessments and trend analysis to anticipate and address labor-related risks.

  • Track and analyze labor relations and HR metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

  • Review Employee Relations communications plans and ensure effective alignment with key stakeholders.

  • Present and deliver labor relations training, projects, business updates, and other initiatives to groups such as, HRBPs, Employee Relations Partners, operational leaders, and/or Quest senior and executive leadership teams.

  • Stay abreast of relevant political, economic, legal, and market developments and trends.

Human Resources Policy

  • In partnership with Human Resources, COEs and legal, develop and maintain company HR policies.

  • Establish or update robust and scalable processes and systems to ensure effective Labor Relations support within Quest.

  • Provide subject matter expertise in specialized regulatory areas (e.g., EEOC, ADA, OFCCP, FMLA, WARN Act, FLSA, trade unions, etc.).

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Labor Relations, or related field, or equivalent professional work experience.

  • At least 10+ years of labor negotiations experience as the chief spokesperson/1st Chair negotiator.

  • 10+ years of demonstrated experience accurately interpreting and applying employment policies and procedures in a large, complex organization.

  • Strong experience with all aspects of labor relations, including knowledge of the National Labor Relations Act and other labor regulations, acts, or laws.

  • Detailed understanding of union organizing campaigns and recognition processes; the collective bargaining process, multi-employer bargaining, and contract negotiation; labor contract interpretation and administration, handling of grievances, mediation, and arbitration; business acquisition and divestiture; NLRB proceedings; and constructive engagement with labor organizations.

  • Ability to leverage a collaborative and supportive approach to lead and motivate teams and end-to-end management of negotiations.

  • Strong ability to build relationships across all stakeholders to drive LR strategy.

Required Competencies

  • Proven ability to balance multiple priorities, partners, and work streams.
  • Strong facilitation and business partnership skills.
  • Effective communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence others in an indirect, matrix-based, and virtual environment.
  • Relationship management, coaching and collaboration skills, with leaders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical, project management, initiative, and creative critical thinking skills.
  • Travel: Between 25-50%.

title: Total Reward Advisor
description:
The Total Reward Advisor acts as an escalation point for all compensation queries. This role supports the delivery of the annual salary review & early careers salary review, administration of the Senior Management Bonus Scheme, job evaluation, salary benchmarking and salary survey submissions. This role is responsible for compiling and analysing compensation data, data visualisation and providing data insights.

The ideal candidate will have strong data analysis skills, excellent attention to detail, confident interpersonal skills and will be able to adapt to change quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Act as an escalation point for all compensation queries into the MyHR Helpdesk that cannot be resolved within the People Services Team

  • Support the Total Reward Business Partner to deliver the annual salary review, early careers salary review and promotion & exceptional increases processes including system configuration (Oracle HCM), data validation, reporting, query resolution and line manager briefings

  • Administration of the Senior Management Bonus Scheme, issuing bonus invitation letters, maintaining bonus participation records, monthly reporting to Finance, bonus payout letters and calculations for payroll

  • Evaluate job descriptions using Willis Towers Watson job evaluation methodology, providing salary benchmarking data and ongoing maintenance of the job architecture

  • Completing salary survey submissions (Willis Towers Watson and other surveys)

  • Calculate the gender pay gap and ethnicity pay gap for legislative reporting

  • Participate in the delivery of total reward presentations to increase colleagues understanding of the value of their total reward package

  • Participate in projects that drive the continuous improvement of our total reward offering

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

Essential

  • Experience working in a Reward, HR or Finance role
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (LOOKUPs, nested IF statements, PIVOT tables and data visualisation using graphs & charts)

title: Transport Ops Controller - 2 Wk shift pattern
description:
Sitting at the heart of M&S’s Fashion, Home & Beauty supply chain, these roles help deliver the daily transport plan across the FHB network and parts of the Ambient Food network. Working closely with third-party logistics partners and internal teams, you’ll make real-time decisions to keep our stores, customers and distribution centres moving, while supporting safe, efficient and cost-effective operations.

We are looking for someone with experience in transport, logistics or supply chain operations who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can make confident decisions under pressure. Strong stakeholder management, organisation and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to coordinate operational changes, prioritise competing demands and build collaborative relationships with internal teams and third-party partners. A passion for safety, service and continuous improvement will help you make a real difference in this role.

There are two 12-month secondment opportunities available, both working 37.5 contracted hours per week on a two-week rotating shift pattern. The rota alternates between Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday & Sunday in Week 1, followed by Wednesday and Thursday in Week 2. The working hours are 6:00am to 6:00pm.

Mandatory office days are Monday – Friday when on shift. Weekends are possible to work from home.

NB: As part of the application process for this position, you will be required to upload a copy of your CV.

What you’ll do

Your key accountabilities will include:

  • Lead the in-day execution of transport operations across the LPC network, ensuring service levels are maintained for distribution centres, stores and customers through effective management of transport plans and third-party logistics partners.
  • Collaborate closely with Planning and Warehouse Operations teams to deliver volumes in line with the transport plan, providing clear and timely communication to stakeholders when operational challenges arise.
  • Monitor and report on key performance metrics including service, cost and safety, ensuring stakeholders have visibility of operational performance and escalating risks or issues where required.
  • Support financial governance through the analysis and reporting of transport volumes, subcontracted activity and associated costs, delivering accurate insights to support management decision-making.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, identifying opportunities to improve ways of working, enhance operational performance and drive continuous improvement across the transport network.

Who you are

Your skills and experience will include:

  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to interpret data from multiple sources and make effective real-time operational decisions
  • Proven ability to build strong relationships and work collaboratively across teams, functions and third-party partners to deliver the best outcomes for the business
  • Experience within a fast-paced transport, logistics, warehousing or retail environment, with a solid understanding of operational challenges and priorities
  • Commercially aware, with an understanding of transport subcontracting, costs and budgets, and the ability to identify opportunities to improve performance and efficiency

  • Proactive and solutions-focused, with the confidence to drive continuous improvement, support change initiatives and contribute to projects from concept through to successful implementation

What’s in it for you?

Working at M&S means being part of something bigger - helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing.

Here are just a few of the benefits that make working here even more rewarding:

  • 20% colleague discount on all M&S products and many third-party brands for you and someone in your household, available once you’ve completed your probation
  • Competitive holiday allowance with the option to buy more
  • Strong pension and life assurance to help plan for the future
  • Tailored induction and training to support your development from day one
  • Exclusive perks and savings through our M&S Choices portal
  • Market-leading family policies, including parental, adoption and neonatal leave
  • 24/7 wellbeing support, including virtual GP access and mental health services
  • One paid volunteer day a year to support a cause that matters to you

Everyone’s welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re reinventing, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re redefining how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.

We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together.

The role will oversee large-scale operations spanning transportation, logistics, freight management, finance & accounting processes, customer service, and back-office operations. title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst (EU Remote), SEAR
description:
As part of our efforts to protect our users, Apple is looking for a world-class senior threat intelligence analyst to join a team of security researchers and threat intelligence analysts. This team works together and cross-functionally to drive efforts to solve security engineering challenges, with an emphasis on supporting decisions that provide the greatest long-term security. The success we are striving for is the result of very skilled people working in an environment that cultivates creativity, partnership, and solving old problems in new ways. Protecting over a billion endpoints. Operationalizing security research and threat intelligence into security engineering decisions affecting every layer of the stack. Touching the lives of everyone who interacts with our products. Working for a company whose commitment to user privacy is at the heart of everything it does. Being surrounded by the most creative, passionate, hardworking engineers in the industry. Constantly being challenged to go beyond the norm to find new, innovative ways of solving problems and to make software safer, easier, and more fun to use. You can find all of this in one opportunity, and only at Apple.

You will have a broad set of skills that make you successful as threats continue to evolve, capable of analyzing cyber threats to our users’ devices. Our environment fosters innovation, rapid solution development, and a liberating amount of autonomy. You will be expected to work with security engineers and researchers in order to quickly bring to market new security methods and technologies addressing the complex needs of mobile and distributed computing.

Minimum Qualifications

  • In-depth understanding of the threat intelligence cycle and cyber operations.
  • Significant years of experience conducting threat research, preferably as a technical lead.
  • Experience in analyzing highly-complex threat actor campaigns, including infrastructure, malware, and victim endpoints.
  • Ability to distill complex problems into manageable tasks and then drive those tasks to completion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Intellectually curious team player with a genuine passion for discovering, understanding, and mitigating cyber threats.
  • Some knowledge of iOS internals.
  • Impeccable attention to detail.
  • Growth mindset, thrives in fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Excellent communications skills (verbal and written).
  • Proven history of successfully working on solo and group projects (experience with virtual/remote collaboration is a plus).
